name: David Hogg, Leaders We Deserve
subject: Leaders We Deserve
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em-onboarding&t=1&akid=393%2E587540%2EXqQh6u)
Hey Peter, it’s David Hogg — co-founder of Leaders We Deserve.
Our kids, our planet, our freedoms, our democracy — are all under attack by far-right extremists, from the State House to the U.S. Senate, who are willing to let children be slaughtered at school and watch our planet burn for their own personal gain.
**We refuse to back down.**
There were many who said after Parkland that we couldn’t change anything because we were just a “bunch of kids.” But we proved them wrong — **we passed gun laws in a state owned by the NRA.**
There were many who said young people would never vote. But we proved them wrong in 2018 — _defeating more NRA-backed politicians than ever before in U.S. history._ Then, in 2020, we defeated NRA puppet Donald Trump. **Both of these victories enabled us to pass the first federal gun law in 30 years.**
There were many who said Maxwell Frost, March For Our Lives' first National Organizing Director, could never be the first Gen Z Member of Congress. **But we proved them wrong, again.**
Badass young people have a habit of being underestimated — and I have a habit of scaring the shit out of Republicans by proving that, while we might be young, we are _powerful._
**That is why I and Kevin Lata, Maxwell Frost’s Campaign Manager and 2022 Campaign Manager of the Year, launched Leaders We Deserve** — a grassroots organization dedicated to electing young leaders to Congress, and especially our State Legislatures, across the country to help defeat the far-right’s agenda and advance a progressive vision for the future. Leaders We Deserve will work in partnership with a stacked Advisory Board, including Maxwell Frost, Justin Jones, and other influential leaders.
[**Are you in? Become a supporter of Leaders We Deserve so we can win back our country and advance a progressive agenda.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-2023-welcome?refcode=em202309-s-393&refcode2=393_587540_XqQh6u&akid=393%2E587540%2EXqQh6u)
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-2023-welcome?refcode=em202309-s-393&refcode2=393_587540_XqQh6u&akid=393%2E587540%2EXqQh6u)**
Why is this important?
**Despite making up 45% of the electorate, Gen Z and Millennials only hold 21% of State Legislature seats.**
Conversely, Republicans have made significant investments in down-ballot races, leading to the absolute assault on our rights and freedoms that we’re seeing happen across states — from abortion bans to taking away LGBTQ+ rights to repealing life-saving common-sense gun laws put into place after the Parkland shooting.
Our political system is stacked against us, but incredible young leaders have fought back and beat the odds to get elected to office. It’s time to take more young people from movements like March For Our Lives and elect them to office to be the leaders we deserve. **But grassroots support is what moves the needle, and it’s what we need from you today.**
[**Join us by donating to support Leaders We Deserve.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-2023-welcome?refcode=em202309-s-393&refcode2=393_587540_XqQh6u&akid=393%2E587540%2EXqQh6u)
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-2023-welcome?refcode=em202309-s-393&refcode2=393_587540_XqQh6u&akid=393%2E587540%2EXqQh6u)**
So how are we going to fight back against the 50-year chess game conservative special interest groups have been manipulating?
**Leaders We Deserve will invest in young people, knock down barriers, and elect more young people to office. We’re doing this by:**
1. **Recruitment:** Identifying candidates who will have the biggest impact on their states (that's where the real work is happening).
2. **Providing Day-to-Day Support:** We’re helping campaigns build from the ground up and will work with them directly on fundraising, messaging, coalition building, voter contact, and volunteer recruitment.
3. **Volunteer Network:** Our grassroots volunteer army (that’s you, Peter) will have person-to-person conversations with voters all across a candidate’s district, advocating on their behalf.
4. **Running Paid Media Campaigns:** We’ll run well-funded independent expenditure programs.

But there’s a reason our political system favors those who are older, wealthier, and white — _running for office takes serious resources._
Which is one of the reasons I’m reaching out. Young candidates aren’t seen as viable and often struggle to raise money. They have lower personal wealth and smaller donor networks.
[**So I’m asking: Will you join our movement and donate to Leaders We Deserve today?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-2023-welcome?refcode=em202309-s-393&refcode2=393_587540_XqQh6u&akid=393%2E587540%2EXqQh6u)
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-2023-welcome?refcode=em202309-s-393&refcode2=393_587540_XqQh6u&akid=393%2E587540%2EXqQh6u)**
There’s so much more I could say, Peter, but I’ll end with this — **we absolutely cannot do this work without you.**
[**Please, pitch in a donation today so we can defeat the far-right extremists who have taken over our communities and our nation — and elect the leaders we deserve.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-2023-welcome?refcode=em202309-s-393&refcode2=393_587540_XqQh6u&akid=393%2E587540%2EXqQh6u)
Thank you.
More soon,
David Hogg
Co-founder
Leaders We Deserve
* * *
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-footer?refcode=em-onboarding&t=2&refcode2=393_587540_XqQh6u&akid=393%2E587540%2EXqQh6u)**

Friend,

**It 's no secret. Our country is in trouble.

Several fires at home and abroad need to be extinguished.**

Joe Biden delivers chaos and confusion.

Inflation makes you pay more for groceries, rent, and utilities.

The border is wide open.

American energy is under assault.

The Middle East is on fire.

Consumer confidence is on the decline. ******TIME IS RUNNING OUT******

The top two go head-to-head in November. I can think of only one thing worse than a General Election ballot that forces Californians to "choose" between three dyed-in-the-wool leftists like Schiff, Porter, or Lee... ...and that's being forced to endure six years of Schiff, Porter, or Lee in the U.S. Senate. I need your help to go "three up...three down" against this lineup of liberal career politicians. That's a bit of baseball vernacular. No surprise, right? It means you record three outs against the first three batters in an inning. Then, it's your team's turn to go on offense. Well, that's very much the case in this election... ...you and I need to strike out this lineup of liberals so we can get to work saving our country. Liberals straight out of Congress where all three have spent a combined 51 years - most recently acting as rubberstamps for the Biden agenda that has done so much harm to our state and our nation. Which is why I'm reaching out to you today. **[Will you step up and help strike out this"lineup of liberals" through a contribution of $15, $25, $50, or more today?](http://links.spiritofpatriots.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=f15743d465b24882bcab83f4324ded21&_e=qVEtmoMZ0lzYxn1R2zv1_Xh4fA0CaiMh_z83ozifY1VWl5pH5QYn-VoBNFHuhpdc2kSDTDNNMBbiu49bLfpzuwsC6q-YCw0XtYqmKRvPybuxOWy3Gj4tUbte_VA-pCvOgH8fYnnFIpQ8yrJZDqwFYqt6jh1Tt-4wBrafEH9sMgF6IHGmN5R1wQa-9uYY_Cl22flWwtPE0GSq8L4NHdRpTwNV5obL_8sM_U0zZJHVWAABZSJmh0GYzLOXeuV8jwdtqHCBUosHAbav1GvU_dW_2oExkeWRS-obqMMC5L1hKa0LspYVp6y8pXq2PQVsMjIRkELFAei_xOn6gS2fpt7aK3bEMOHkP91hZpNl0MZTqk2hEYype1semwtzbY18dsjRyFVYO7DgI9dDU1fyT0OuZw%3D%3D)** Think about the crumbling quality of life in my once-great state of California. Think about the daily reality of:
---
• Fear of walking down the street, taking their kids to school, or running a small business because of rampant crime, homelessness, and drug addiction. • The exploding cost of living (gas, food, shelter) which for the first time in our history is causing more people to leave California. • Failing public schools and plummeting test scores. The numbers don't lie... prolonged school closings not only robbed our kids of learning but of social interaction.
---
If you believe, as I do, that voters deserve better than a "false choice" between Schiff, Porter, and Lee on November 5, 2024, **[**then I need you to take immediate action and rush a contribution of $15, $25, $50, or more today.**](http://links.spiritofpatriots.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=f15743d465b24882bcab83f4324ded21&_e=qVEtmoMZ0lzYxn1R2zv1_Xh4fA0CaiMh_z83ozifY1VWl5pH5QYn-VoBNFHuhpdc2kSDTDNNMBbiu49bLfpzuwsC6q-YCw0XtYqmKRvPybuxOWy3Gj4tUbte_VA-pCvOgH8fYnnFIpQ8yrJZDqwFYqt6jh1Tt-4wBrafEH9sMgF6IHGmN5R1wQa-9uYY_Cl22flWwtPE0GSq8L4NHdRpTwNV5obL_8sM_U0zZJHVWAAJk5ig2_ot7FOVgw87GB52tldyWAhKz3NErooPsKl0sexgoPJwQDfBSR1zlJGrn7clUsR7fWKpFe-I9-WLXyVpdl1MkMCf-a9rNMXFgMlQqcaTi4PNZqKDF6EWotVDuB3muWaxsX8-kleFEZvf2Vdl7LFXc4aAXofLWB3OX2VSrQ%3D%3D)** Winning this election requires a one-two punch:
---
1\. Finish in the top two on March 5th (very doable as the Democrat vote will be split three ways). 2\. An eight-month grassroots and TV, radio, and online campaign "connecting the dots" between the policies pushed by Schiff/Porter/Lee and the brutal reality facing Californians every day.

clean_body: | | | | | | Fellow American, That's the day of the California primary. The top two go head-to-head in November. I can think of only one thing worse than a General Election ballot that forces Californians to "choose" between three dyed-in-the-wool leftists like Schiff, Porter, or Lee... ...and that's being forced to endure six years of Schiff, Porter, or Lee in the U.S. Senate. I need your help to go "three up...three down" against this lineup of liberal career politicians. That's a bit of baseball vernacular. No surprise, right? It means you record three outs against the first three batters in an inning. Then, it's your team's turn to go on offense. Well, that's very much the case in this election... ...you and I need to strike out this lineup of liberals so we can get to work saving our country. Liberals straight out of Congress where all three have spent a combined 51 years - most recently acting as rubberstamps for the Biden agenda that has done so much harm to our state and our nation. Which is why I'm reaching out to you today. Think about the crumbling quality of life in my once-great state of California. Think about the daily reality of: • Fear of walking down the street, taking their kids to school, or running a small business because of rampant crime, homelessness, and drug addiction. • The exploding cost of living (gas, food, shelter) which for the first time in our history is causing more people to leave California. • Failing public schools and plummeting test scores. The numbers don't lie... prolonged school closings not only robbed our kids of learning but of social interaction. If you believe, as I do, that voters deserve better than a "false choice" between Schiff, Porter, and Lee on November 5, 2024, Winning this election requires a one-two punch: 1\. Finish in the top two on March 5th (very doable as the Democrat vote will be split three ways). 2\. An eight-month grassroots and TV, radio, and online campaign "connecting the dots" between the policies pushed by Schiff/Porter/Lee and the brutal reality facing Californians every day. In my playing days, I would never be out-worked or out-hustled. That's my approach to this campaign. Door-knocks, phone-calls, rallies, townhalls, you name it. With you on our side, I'm confident we can not only give voters a real choice, but someone who remembers how great California was and knows how great it can be again. | | With deepest appreciation, Steve Garvey Republican for United States Senate | | | | | | | MY VISION My campaign is focused on quality-of-life issues, public safety, and education. As your U.S. Senator, I will serve with commonsense, compassion, and will work to build consensus to benefit all of the people of California. I've been fortunate to wear many hats in life - from professional athlete to businessman to philanthropist. But the one thing that has remained consistent is my love for this great state and my desire to make a difference. In baseball, it's not about the individual; it's about the team. I believe the same holds true for politics. | | **Today,[I’m asking you to help me defeat the radical Adam Schiff for a seat in the United States Senate.](http://email.email.freethinkerdaily.com/c/eJw8j09vozAQxT-NuRnZ43_pgUNSErSHqlK6jbQn5NhDYi0GZEwrvv2KbNTLHH7z5s17Nk596NaKmAMBuAc_EwAi9gRgyeJiPz_f0krfd4k26gK3bQmvBCCvE_4onyYlRhv6jZq68JUEyztXYMUN2zEpjDLFvQLFXzTz191OSOG44F5pjd54j8CBQxEqYCAZcM2YUMqUV_SgFADTXGvVKSLZ41HZJcR8D8NfTN6Gfi3dGIu-uuc8zY9gJwKnGd2SsPwOQ0K_KTaW8QvpzaYvXGk3JrrMdMbBZiRwMtoZL7qr0y_cSKmIOC05tvO4JIdE1Ie6oefjhYDecEQflkhEfXx7EmfjZMNtIKL-X4RBe6ib9qN53bd_3ptf7fl4aT9-7890G8-rjGlz6bKHIlV--g59H2ZtiGS3R1k3xn8BAAD__8YngbU)** Today, I’m asking you to help me start a Republican Comeback Rally that folks will be talking about for generations to come. Because when you think about it, those ‘good-ol’ days of the 1970s weren’t as good as we tend to first remember. Baseball was just a welcome distraction from the gloom and malaise that had settled on our country thanks to one failed Democrat policy after another. I’m running for the United States Senate because 2024 America is starting to look a lot like 1970s America. You remember what it was like: \- Not only were gas prices sky high, Carter’s rationing meant we could only buy gas on even or odd days depending on our license plate numbers. **_Remember?_** \- Eleven Israeli athletes were slaughtered at the Olympic Village in Munich by terrorists. **_Remember?_** \- Fifty-two Americans were held hostage for 444 days by terrorists in Iran. **_Remember??_** Democrat policies had brought America to its knees. And now, as Yogi Berra used to say, “It’s déjà vu all over again.” There’s fear of walking down the street because of rampant crime, homelessness, and drug addiction. The cost of living is exploding and for the first time causing more people to leave California. Joe Biden, Adam Schiff and the rest of the Democrats don’t care one bit that Americans are having a hard time. I’d go even further to say they _welcome_ the misery so they can keep folks down and dependent. And I wouldn’t blame you if you said, “Steve, I’m afraid America’s best days are behind us.” But listen, here’s something I also want you to remember... **_We Republicans_ ****pulled our country out of that 1970’s Democratic malaise by electing Ronald Reagan.** **We put classic conservative values at the heart of everything we did.** **And America became a shining city upon a hill once more.** _**We can do that again**_**.** **It starts by stunning the Democrats with a Senate win in California.** **But there’s no way I can pull it off without you.** **That’s why I’m asking you to rush in your $35 donation today** I’m sorry for the urgency but _the primary is in less than three months_ and here’s where things stand... In March, I need to be one of the top 2 vote-getters to get to the November general election. Adam Schiff will probably take the #1 spot. And polls have me hot on his heels for the #2 spot. Once we’re passed the primary, I know with your help, I can beat him in November. Why? First... I’ve lived and worked in California for over 50 years, and I can tell you –- voters here have had it with the Democrats like I’ve never seen before. They are hungry for change, and if you and I work together to reach voters in every neighborhood, on every beach, in every corner of California... I know we can turn this historic opportunity into a Republican win. Second... you know I’m not a career politician. But I do have the one thing a Republican needs to get elected in California... ...name recognition. I’m no Schwarzenegger and I’d certainly never dare compare myself to President Reagan. But California voters know me. And Adam Schiff and the Democrats are shaking in their boots seeing how quickly I rose in the polls after entering the race. As I’m writing you this email, there are just a few percentage points separating us. We’ve got a shot –- a very real shot -- of landing smack behind Schiff in the primary so we can go on to beat him in the general election. But there are just three months left until the primary. And the giant Democrat political machine is going to use every second of that time trying to bury me and our common sense message. **[**When you rush back your _Garvey for Senate_ campaign contribution of $35 or more...**](http://email.email.freethinkerdaily.com/c/eJw8j09vozAQxT-NuRnZ43_pgUNSErSHqlK6jbQn5NhDYi0GZEwrvv2KbNTLHH7z5s17Nk596NaKmAMBuAc_EwAi9gRgyeJiPz_f0krfd4k26gK3bQmvBCCvE_4onyYlRhv6jZq68JUEyztXYMUN2zEpjDLFvQLFXzTz191OSOG44F5pjd54j8CBQxEqYCAZcM2YUMqUV_SgFADTXGvVKSLZ41HZJcR8D8NfTN6Gfi3dGIu-uuc8zY9gJwKnGd2SsPwOQ0K_KTaW8QvpzaYvXGk3JrrMdMbBZiRwMtoZL7qr0y_cSKmIOC05tvO4JIdE1Ie6oefjhYDecEQflkhEfXx7EmfjZMNtIKL-X4RBe6ib9qN53bd_3ptf7fl4aT9-7890G8-rjGlz6bKHIlV--g59H2ZtiGS3R1k3xn8BAAD__8YngbU)** ...you’re helping fund ads, appearances, events, fliers, door knockers, EVERYTHING that blankets California with the message: _You don’t have to accept failed Democrat policies that make all of us less safe, less prosperous, and less free._ This race is the toughest in the nation. But they say the hardest thing to do in sports is hit a 95-mph fastball. And you know I’ve done that plenty of times. Now I’m ready to do the hardest thing in American politics –- win in California as a common sense Republican. But I can’t do it without you. I’m fighting for the soul of the state I love -- but make no mistake -- I’m not just taking the field for Californians. When we win here... when we rip this seat out the hands of the radical Adam Schiff... ...we start the nationwide Republican Comeback Rally our country desperately needs. It all depends on you! You can do nothing and continue to suffer the agony of defeat. clean_body: We can win in California again | | | | | | Dear Patriot, If you opened this email because you remember my playing days with the Dodgers and the Padres, thank you. | | Having you and all of America’s baseball fans cheering for me and Davey Lopes, Bill Russell, Ron Cey and the rest of the guys as we battled Reggie Jackson, Thurman Munson and the Yankees... ...well, as they say, “Those were the days.” But this email isn’t about baseball. In fact, it’s a email I never thought I’d be writing to you. | | | Today, Today, I’m asking you to help me start a Republican Comeback Rally that folks will be talking about for generations to come. Because when you think about it, those ‘good-ol’ days of the 1970s weren’t as good as we tend to first remember. Baseball was just a welcome distraction from the gloom and malaise that had settled on our country thanks to one failed Democrat policy after another. I’m running for the United States Senate because 2024 America is starting to look a lot like 1970s America. You remember what it was like: \- Not only were gas prices sky high, Carter’s rationing meant we could only buy gas on even or odd days depending on our license plate numbers. Remember? \- Eleven Israeli athletes were slaughtered at the Olympic Village in Munich by terrorists. Remember? \- Fifty-two Americans were held hostage for 444 days by terrorists in Iran. Remember?? Democrat policies had brought America to its knees. And now, as Yogi Berra used to say, “It’s déjà vu all over again.” There’s fear of walking down the street because of rampant crime, homelessness, and drug addiction. The cost of living is exploding and for the first time causing more people to leave California. Joe Biden, Adam Schiff and the rest of the Democrats don’t care one bit that Americans are having a hard time. I’d go even further to say they welcome the misery so they can keep folks down and dependent. And I wouldn’t blame you if you said, “Steve, I’m afraid America’s best days are behind us.” But listen, here’s something I also want you to remember... We Republicans pulled our country out of that 1970’s Democratic malaise by electing Ronald Reagan. We put classic conservative values at the heart of everything we did. And America became a shining city upon a hill once more. We can do that again. It starts by stunning the Democrats with a Senate win in California. But there’s no way I can pull it off without you. That’s why I’m asking you to rush in your $35 donation today I’m sorry for the urgency but the primary is in less than three months and here’s where things stand... In March, I need to be one of the top 2 vote-getters to get to the November general election. Adam Schiff will probably take the #1 spot. And polls have me hot on his heels for the #2 spot. Once we’re passed the primary, I know with your help, I can beat him in November. Why? First... I’ve lived and worked in California for over 50 years, and I can tell you –- voters here have had it with the Democrats like I’ve never seen before. They are hungry for change, and if you and I work together to reach voters in every neighborhood, on every beach, in every corner of California... I know we can turn this historic opportunity into a Republican win. Second... you know I’m not a career politician. But I do have the one thing a Republican needs to get elected in California... ...name recognition. I’m no Schwarzenegger and I’d certainly never dare compare myself to President Reagan. But California voters know me. And Adam Schiff and the Democrats are shaking in their boots seeing how quickly I rose in the polls after entering the race. As I’m writing you this email, there are just a few percentage points separating us. We’ve got a shot –- a very real shot -- of landing smack behind Schiff in the primary so we can go on to beat him in the general election. But there are just three months left until the primary. And the giant Democrat political machine is going to use every second of that time trying to bury me and our common sense message. ...you’re helping fund ads, appearances, events, fliers, door knockers, EVERYTHING that blankets California with the message: You don’t have to accept failed Democrat policies that make all of us less safe, less prosperous, and less free. This race is the toughest in the nation. But they say the hardest thing to do in sports is hit a 95-mph fastball. And you know I’ve done that plenty of times. Now I’m ready to do the hardest thing in American politics –- win in California as a common sense Republican. But I can’t do it without you. I’m fighting for the soul of the state I love -- but make no mistake -- I’m not just taking the field for Californians. When we win here... when we rip this seat out the hands of the radical Adam Schiff... ...we start the nationwide Republican Comeback Rally our country desperately needs. It all depends on you! You can do nothing and continue to suffer the agony of defeat. Or you can . Please join me. Because when we win in California, we’re winning for all of America. Thank you and God Bless, | | Steve Garvey Republican for United States Senate | | | P.S. It’s the bottom of the 9th and Republicans desperately need a homerun. We simply can’t let another election slip through our fingers while Democrats go on destroying our country. With your help, I know we can beat Adam Schiff in California and start the Republican Comeback Rally America needs. But the primary is in just three months. Thank you! –Steve | | | | | | | | | PAID FOR BY STEVE GARVEY FOR U.S. SENATE | | |

name: Gene Karpinski, LCV
subject: URGENT: House votes 210-209 to force through climate-killing methane gas exports
body:
Time sensitive

Peter - our Membership Drive deadline is a few days away, and we're reaching out because we haven't heard from you yet (renew your membership here and your contribution will be tripled https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/_ ).

The truth is your membership matters, and it's particularly critical right now.

Here's the situation: Earlier this month, Senator Joe Manchin backed away from a climate deal after months of negotiations, choosing to side with Big Oil and Republicans. It leaves the deal one vote short -- stalling any real action in Congress for now.

In response, we're redoubling our efforts on pushing the White House to act decisively on climate. The Biden administration has massive amounts of power to curb climate pollution - but that will only happen if the environmental movement makes it happen.

Right now, we're facing a critical test: the Biden administration is weighing a plan to block all new oil and gas drilling leases on public waters.

This could be huge -- and a decision is coming. Right now, we're organizing volunteers from all over the country to flood the administration with letters, pressuring Biden to hold to his promises.

Peter -- it's your membership support that makes victory possible here. But we have to do more. A group of donors has put together a fund to triple match every contribution before Sunday's membership deadline:

Can we count on your support? Claim your membership now - it only takes $5 >> https://links.messages.lcv.

The ban on new oil and gas leases is the first of many huge environmental decisions, Peter. And right now, we're pushing for serious action on so many fronts -- including:
Setting tight standards for power plants and other major emitters of climate pollution
Placing strict limits on air pollution to safeguard all communities Expediting requirements of 100% tailpipe pollution-free new cars by 2035 and trucks by 2040
Protecting communities from hazardous and super-polluting methane Conserving 30% of our public lands and waters by 2030 Declaring a climate emergency - and so much more. The best way you can help win each and every one of these fights right now is to claim your LCV membership - all it takes is a gift of $5 or more. https://links.messages.lcv.

Thank you, thank you, thank you, Peter. This is such a critical moment for the environment, and we're so fortunate to have you on the team.

Onward,

Gene Karpinski
President
League of Conservation Voters

subject: Voting with Empathy, Serving with Empathy
body:
Why do we elect politicians who don't care? | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mullenformontana/voting-with-empathy-serving-with-empathy?e=805e709ff8)
---
_Due to a technical glitch, we are sending this email again. If you received a copy earlier today, it is the same._
[](https://jessejamesmullen.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ead1108518cb8f41430a7b0b3&id=8b046ca040&e=805e709ff8)
[](https://jessejamesmullen.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ead1108518cb8f41430a7b0b3&id=c8bdb5dd38&e=805e709ff8)
_Emily, left, Jesse James, middle, and Louis Mullen, Christmas 1986, opening stuffed Dinosaurs Grandma Mullen made._
Hey team, it’s Jesse James,
A warning: This email may be difficult for some to read.
Today is my little sister’s birthday. Emily was born three years after me – I was born in 1984, Louis in 1985, Emily in 1987, and Lloyd in 1988. Yes, we are Irish Catholic. Why do you ask?
If you remember my email from Sunday, there were three brothers in those photos, no sister.
My mother was seven months pregnant with my brother Lloyd when my sister died. Just before Mother’s Day, 1988, my sister suddenly became sick. My parents took me and Louis to the neighbor’s house while Emily went to the hospital where my mom worked. That was the last time I saw my sister.
[](https://jessejamesmullen.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ead1108518cb8f41430a7b0b3&id=5c20efe92b&e=805e709ff8)
_My mom, about to graduate from nursing school._
Meningitis is a terrible disease
To say that was a formative moment during my childhood is an understatement.
Today, Meningitis is easily preventable. But thousands of Montana children were kicked off Medicaid in 2023 by Montana’s Republican Party. That and a rising anti-vaccine movement have me worried about the future of healthcare in our state.
Montana MUST elect reasonable and empathetic people who understand how important healthcare is to most Montanans.
I want you to talk to three people today who ignore politics. Please let them know how important these elections are. This isn’t just about a race to win Secretary of State and voter access. We need your support in the State House and Senate, where the future of our healthcare is decided. We still have many uncontested GOP seats and only a few weeks to find candidates. If you know someone who should run, please get in touch with the [MDLCC](https://jessejamesmullen.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ead1108518cb8f41430a7b0b3&id=7840fcadc0&e=805e709ff8).
And if you can, [please donate](https://jessejamesmullen.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ead1108518cb8f41430a7b0b3&id=ab922be91a&e=805e709ff8) to this campaign, too.
Thank you,Jesse James Mullen

| [DONATE HERE](https://jessejamesmullen.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ead1108518cb8f41430a7b0b3&id=2d5e50ca66&e=805e709ff8)
---
[](https://jessejamesmullen.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ead1108518cb8f41430a7b0b3&id=56c60f0f79&e=805e709ff8)
_My oldest daughter, Emily, the baby in this photo, was born 16 years and 11 months after the anniversary of my sister Emily’s passing. My mother raised her three boys and now has six granddaughters, one grandson, and one great-grandson. My mom is in the background of this photo, and her father, my grandfather, is holding his great-granddaughter, Emily._
|
---

body:
More storms are expected this weekend.
#
Last week, California was pummeled by an atmospheric river storm system intensified by climate change. The state received more than half of its annual rainfall in just 2 days1 — triggering over 560 mudslides, displacing thousands of people evacuated from flood zones, and leaving at least 9 people dead.2
This weekend, California is expected to be hit by 2 more storms.
[Today, we’re launching a direct relief fundraiser for a California organization working to help the thousands of people impacted by the flooding. Can you make a $5 contribution today to help relief efforts?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240215-ca.-GP-Vr&refcode=em20240215-5833-P_FND_EGR_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=5833%2E2526796%2EUpI-2g)

_**100% of your donation will directly benefit these groups.**_
**United Way of Ventura County** and **United Way of Greater Los Angeles** are both working to assist low-income residents of Los Angeles and Ventura Counties, where some regions reported nearly 9 inches of rainfall in less than 36 hours. United Way is now working to provide food, clothing, and monetary assistance to impacted residents.
[You can help make a major difference right now to affected Californians by making a $5 contribution to provide direct, on-the-ground relief. Can they count on your $5 contribution today?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240215-ca.-GP-Vr&refcode=em20240215-5833-P_FND_EGR_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=5833%2E2526796%2EUpI-2g)

_**100% of your donation will directly benefit these groups.**_
Our thoughts are with those who have lost their homes, livelihoods, or loved ones during the storms.
Together, we can help our communities rebuild after climate-related disasters.
In solidarity,
Team AOC

in November.

way to help Joe Biden.”

name: Elise Stefanik
subject: I just filed a request to DISBAR Letitia James
body:
Help me end the lawfare against President Trump. I just filed a request with the New York Committee on Professional Standards urging the state’s Attorney Grievance Committee to investigate and disbar AG Letitia James for her unprofessional and malicious handling of her case against President Trump.
| Fellow American, I wanted you to hear about this from me. _**I just filed a request with the New York Committee on Professional Standards urging the state 's Attorney Grievance Committee to investigate and disbar AG Letitia James for her unprofessional and malicious handling of her case against President Trump.**_ As open borders policies and disastrous "no bail" laws have led to a crime wave in the Empire State it appears that NY's Attorney General is only interested in launching personal attacks against her political opponents and prosecuting a non-criminal dispute over the value of some of President Trump's real estate assets. To a non-partisan observer this would seem confusing but Letitia James has made it clear that her primary mission as AG is to go after President Trump. And this personal vendetta goes all the way back to the beginning of Trump's Presidency. At that time Ms. James was leading "die-in" protests against President Trump and claimed that she was leading "the resistance" against him in NYC where she will "continue to do so in every way possible." But it did not stop there. She then proceeded to build her entire campaign platform for AG in 2018 on a promise to Democrat voters that she would find any way possible to criminally charge President Trump whether he was innocent or not. **Her behavior does not reflect the actions of an unbiased attorney seeking justice but rather the actions of a partisan delivering on campaign promises.** The entire case against President Trump is just an example of Democrat lawfare where Radical Leftists abuse their positions of power to weaponize our government and judicial system to go after their political opponents. It cannot be understated how damaging these partisan witch-hunts are for the country and they must be put to an end immediately. As the late Supreme Court Justice Antonin Scalia once eloquently stated "the distinctiveness of America is the structure of our government". **If we let Extremists like Letitia James destroy the independence of our judiciary then the rights of all Americans will be nothing more than what Scalia described as a "parchment guarantee".** [**That 's why it is crucial that patriots from across the nation join me and demand the immediate investigation and disbarment of NY Attorney General Letitia James.**](http://links.primaryupdate.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=983aff4e3ce44422aed34af79a19b89d&_e=DJPIiwgl-bkzObO7RK7OwHmEmrLhYht-2Cd-rGQ-9HVInX5r_XxPQl7k5CycBINjwu6ep6Fs_s8yAsYFFtrAr78cUNwIV80M8FzMXeDfv_gyCEaf_-bB6nQrAAujiAG3fzPP7txZPxKmlx6f4q3j08c67MaMtu3YMFkXxgE3Xzj8KFZMX43tBxUqL1n9QGdudneXwCn01C-2Np6NypekHj7eFSPjR5rYmktxJbyrzk-wnIb0Eqghi0_W1bHEXkN9ClHD0PcW-zZ_dQux3Ho5jWuCEp0iYSgk7tVgH5ZQ8wfeAT7dgqfVXrBzBWagktP9nCHe2B1RsYydQLpBJYGvBA%3D%3D)

Folks, I won’t take up too much of your time, but I wanted you to know that tonight is our first fundraising deadline since a mega-millionaire hedge fund executive officially became our only Republican opponent. Frankly, I can’t just write a half-a-million dollar check like my challenger did to get ahead in our fundraising. _And I wouldn’t want to even if I could_ — I’m proud to count on the support of folks like you who share the priorities I’m fighting for in the Senate. **I’m also proud of the progress we’ve made together: Protecting our environment. name: Andrew Hughes
subject: Should Dr. Ben Carson Be Canceled?
body:
| | Please see a special message from our sponsor.
---
| |
---
| | | [](http://trk.libertyledger._OQYePMQ)
---
| Fellow Patriot,

Dr. Carson asked me to reach out to Americans who want what’s best for our country, to help him take a stand against “cancel culture.” It’s tearing our country apart and needs to be stopped.

This is something he has experienced firsthand.

As you may have heard, this past November the Detroit School Board voted to change the name of the Benjamin Carson High School of Science and Medicine. Why? Because the School Board was mad that Dr. Carson was part of the Trump Administration!

These educational leaders – who should be acting as role models for our kids – instead decided to create a huge political spectacle by “canceling” Dr. Carson and trying to erase his amazing achievements as a doctor, as a leader, and as a citizen. It’s really outrageous.

Dr. Carson is disappointed by this – not because he wants any glory but because it sets a bad example ... for the kids at this school, and for the entire country.

“Cancel culture” tells young people and all Americans that you shouldn’t listen to those with whom you disagree and try to find common ground; you should just stigmatize them and erase them.

The Left probably expected Dr. Carson to lash out at the Detroit School Board and his political opponents – hurl some insults, call people names, keep the fight going.

But instead, Dr. Carson said to our team here at the American Cornerstone Institute (ACI):

_“What if we use this as an opportunity to rally people across the country to speak out against cancel culture? To show America that we have a better path forward for our country than hate and division?”_

And that’s exactly what we’re doing. It’s why Dr. Carson launched ACI in the first place – to lead the way for what’s best for our country.

And we’ve created a way for you to stand with Dr. Carson and make your voice heard. Just click the link below; it will take you to our **National Statement Against Cancel Culture** that you can review and then co-sign.

[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/cancel-culture-pledge](http://trk.libertyledger.)

Dr. Carson is getting asked about the Detroit school incident quite a bit, and when he answers he wants to speak for Americans who are heartbroken by what cancel culture is doing to our country – who want this divisiveness and vitriol to end! I think you’re just such an American.

And when you and thousands of concerned citizens like you sign this Statement, Dr. Carson will be able to keep speaking from the heart against cancel culture – knowing that he’s broadcasting a message that is important to his fellow Americans.

He can say ... “Enough is enough! I’m fed up with cancel culture, and so are folks everywhere who love America and want what’s best for the country.”

If that’s a message you want Dr. Carson to share on your behalf, please take a moment now to be part of ACI’s **National Statement Against Cancel Culture**. Here’s the link again for you:

[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/cancel-culture-pledge](http://trk.libertyledger._jwTvXYpttDXg)

Amid all the divisiveness and polarization that has been injected into our policy debates, Dr. Carson is proud of the work ACI is doing to encourage Americans to come together despite our differences and find ways to take on the challenges that face our country.

I hope you’ll join Dr. Carson in this important work. Thank you!

Sincerely,

Andrew D. Hughes
Executive Director & CEO
American Cornerstone Institute

# **President Trump's Dire Warning!!!**
---
|
---
| | [](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=s8ybe7)
---
| | President Donald J. Trump has issued a dire warning about not only America... But the currency we all depend on to make a living - **the U.S. Dollar.** In a recent interview, he stated that...
---
“Our country is going to hell and we're not going to be the big boy," Trump said. "We have power, but it's waning. In fact, it's waning in terms of our currency. And I'm not just talking about the value of our currency, I'm talking about our currency being used throughout the world." He went on to say that losing the U.S. dollar’s reserve currency status for the world is **"bigger than losing any war."**
---
Is he right? Well, this isn’t the first prediction President Trump has made. He previously warned that Biden would "demolish" the American dream if he won the White House, and that the Democrats would unleash "violent anarchists" on US cities. **So what should you do about President Trump’s new warning?** How does this potentially impact your retirement savings and your quality of life?
---

[YES](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c39394%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=CB%2b%2fWc6q%2fm95ggDGU4BSZA&sysid=1) [NO](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c39305%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=gNaqR6mBZ7r8%2bO0I3DrGbg&sysid=1) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. | | | Donald Trump and his lawyers are claiming that he has "total immunity" for any crimes committed as president. They are even going so far as to claim he could order US troops to assassinate a political rival. The claim is preposterous, it's simply meant as a delay tactic, and the Supreme Court shouldn't waste time on motions and filings and arguments -- it should reject it out of hand, let the lower court's ruling stand, and allow the trial to proceed. [**Add your name: Tell the Supreme Court to Immediately Reject Trump's "Total Immunity" Claim**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T4c7a34e9-3b4a-4864-bee6-f887f61d8d62/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) The Supreme Court does not have an obligation to spend time on every case, regardless of how absurd it is. If Trump claimed he was immune, because he was actually a unicorn, and magical creatures can't be prosecuted by human courts, we wouldn't waste time on it. And we shouldn't waste time on this claim, which is also just plain absurd. # **A Message from the Chairwoman**
---
| | ** _Final Call, Sign Up!_**
---
Friends, We are one week away from our 2024 Congress of Counties, and time is running out to sign up!!! **Monday February 19th by 5:00 PM is the deadline to** [register](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/e4ccc0684ba8b54e3947229f28c3afba/a6b8b2e4ba7a422ec3d6b838967d376c/40313) and make sure you have a spot, that is only 3 DAYS AWAY. We are calling members of our party from all 92 counties to sign up and help us make a difference. If you want to get involved in the pivotal 2024 election cycle, THIS EVENT IS A MUST. # 🚨Bidenflation Continues to Surge❗

---
---
| | [Tuesday’s inflation report](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/e4ccc0684ba8b54e3947229f28c3afba/6ba12410b9641107c3d6b838967d376c/40313) from the Bureau of Labor Statistics confirms that inflation isn’t going anywhere. Due to Joe Biden's economic policies, this report indicates inflation is going to continue to skyrocket. **What does the inflation report mean? Everything costs more... and it's going from bad to worse! ** January’s Consumer Price Index rose [3.1%](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/e4ccc0684ba8b54e3947229f28c3afba/c70eeba92ca811a8c3d6b838967d376c/40313) compared to last year.
* Auto insurance is up 20.6%
* $100 a month in 2023 ➡️ $120.60 a month in 2024

* Household repairs are up 18.2%
* $1,000 in 2023 ➡️ $1,182 in 2024

* Sporting events are up 13.5%
* $300 in 2023 ➡️ $390.50 in 2024

* Transportation services are up 9.5%
* $500 a month in 2023 ➡️ $547.50 a month in 2024

* Nonprescription drugs are up 9.2%
* $50 a month in 2023 ➡️ $54.60 a month in 2024

* Baby food is up 8.7%
* $200 a month in 2023 ➡️ $217.40 a month in 2024

* Shelter is up 6.0%
* $1,500 a month in 2023 ➡️ $1,590 a month in 2024

* Eating out is up 5.1%
* $150 to feed a family out to eat in 2023 ➡️ $157.65 in 2024

Prices have risen by [17.9%](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/e4ccc0684ba8b54e3947229f28c3afba/81db2398814846edc3d6b838967d376c/40313) overall since Biden took office. This means the buying power of a $100 bill in 2021 would get you less in 2024, with buying power closer to $85. On a year-over-year basis, inflation under Biden has [averaged 5.7%](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/e4ccc0684ba8b54e3947229f28c3afba/d25b8c5e830db705c3d6b838967d376c/40313) – **more than double the level of inflation seen under any of the last four presidents.** The average middle-class household [lost over $33,000 in real wealth](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/e4ccc0684ba8b54e3947229f28c3afba/54455485e099bba7c3d6b838967d376c/40313) from March 2022 to March 2023. **That is money Hoosiers wont get back.** The current state of inflation is unacceptable and outrageous, with prices significantly higher than they were just three years ago. Bidenflation has severely impacted Hoosiers, setting back financial plans and savings by years. The recent inflation report underscores the disarray America is experiencing under Joe Biden, **highlighting the urgency to elect conservative Republicans in 2024 to restore stability.**

It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection **by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/kwnn4sKKwja3GXy1ePE_Og~~/AARclAA~/RgRnsdl2P0S-aHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L2VsZWN0b3JhbC1jb2xsZWdlLXN1cnZleS8_c2M9MDA1ODROMDI0MkwwQURPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPWVsZWN0b3JhbF9jb2xsZWdlX3N1cnZleSZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1ZRVNOT1NIT1JUX1BBLVJPTi0yMDI0MDIxNlcDc3BjQgplzkk9z2Vp-DlqUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)** Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vs_D5GWiN5

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/os_D5GWiN5

Dear
Fellow Patriot,
If you
opened this email because you remember my playing days with the
Dodgers and the Padres, thank you.

Having
you and all of America's baseball fans cheering for me and Davey
Lopes, Bill Russell, Ron Cey and the rest of the guys as we
battled Reggie Jackson, Thurman Munson and the Yankees...
...well,
as they say, "Those were the days."
But this
email isn't about baseball. In fact, it's a email I never thought
I'd be writing to you.

Today,
I'm asking you to help me defeat the radical Adam Schiff for a
seat in the United States Senate.
Today,
I'm asking you to help me start a Republican Comeback Rally that
folks will be talking about for generations to come.
Because
when you think about it, those 'good-ol' days of the 1970s
weren't as good as we tend to first remember.
Baseball
was just a welcome distraction from the gloom and malaise that
had settled on our country thanks to one failed Democrat policy
after another.
I'm
running for the United States Senate because 2024 America is
starting to look a lot like 1970s America.
You
remember what it was like:
- Not
only were gas prices sky high, Carter's rationing meant we could
only buy gas on even or odd days depending on our license
plate numbers. Remember?
- Eleven
Israeli athletes were slaughtered at the Olympic Village in
Munich by terrorists. Remember?
-
Fifty-two Americans were held hostage for 444 days by terrorists
in Iran. Remember??
Democrat
policies had brought America to its knees.
And now,
as Yogi Berra used to say, "It's déjà vu all over again."
There's
fear of walking down the street because of rampant crime,
homelessness, and drug addiction. The cost of living is exploding
and for the first time causing more people to leave California.
Joe
Biden, Adam Schiff and the rest of the Democrats don't care one
bit that Americans are having a hard time. I'd go even further to
say they welcome the misery so they can keep folks down and
dependent.
And I
wouldn't blame you if you said, "Steve, I'm afraid America's best
days are behind us."
But
listen, here's something I also want you to remember...
We
Republicans pulled our country out of that 1970's Democratic
malaise by electing Ronald Reagan.
We put
classic conservative values at the heart of everything we did.
And
America became a shining city upon a hill once more.
We can do
that again.
It starts
by stunning the Democrats with a Senate win in California.
But
there's no way I can pull it off without you.
That's
why I'm asking you to rush in your $35 donation today
I'm sorry
for the urgency but the primary is in less than three months and
here's where things stand...
In March,
I need to be one of the top 2 vote-getters to get to the November
general election.
Adam
Schiff will probably take the #1 spot. And polls have me hot on
his heels for the #2 spot.
Once
we're passed the primary, I know with your help, I can beat him
in November.
Why?
First...
I've lived and worked in California for over 50 years, and I can
tell you -- voters here have had it with the Democrats like I've
never seen before.
They are
hungry for change, and if you and I work together to reach voters
in every neighborhood, on every beach, in every corner of
California...
I know we
can turn this historic opportunity into a Republican win.
Second...
you know I'm not a career politician.
But I do
have the one thing a Republican needs to get elected in
California...
...name
recognition.
I'm no
Schwarzenegger and I'd certainly never dare compare myself to
President Reagan.
But
California voters know me.
And Adam
Schiff and the Democrats are shaking in their boots seeing how
quickly I rose in the polls after entering the race.
As I'm
writing you this email, there are just a few percentage points
separating us.
We've got
a shot -- a very real shot -- of landing smack behind Schiff in
the primary so we can go on to beat him in the general election.
But there
are just three months left until the primary.
And the
giant Democrat political machine is going to use every second of
that time trying to bury me and our common sense message.
When you
rush back your Garvey for Senate campaign contribution of $35 or
more...
...you're
helping fund ads, appearances, events, fliers, door knockers,
EVERYTHING that blankets California with the message:
You don't
have to accept failed Democrat policies that make all of us less
safe, less prosperous, and less free.
This race
is the toughest in the nation.
But they
say the hardest thing to do in sports is hit a 95-mph fastball.
And you
know I've done that plenty of times.
Now I'm
ready to do the hardest thing in American politics -- win in
California as a common sense Republican.
But I
can't do it without you.
I'm
fighting for the soul of the state I love -- but make no mistake
-- I'm not just taking the field for Californians.
When we
win here... when we rip this seat out the hands of the radical
Adam Schiff...
...we
start the nationwide Republican Comeback Rally our country
desperately needs.
It all
depends on you!
You can
do nothing and continue to suffer the agony of defeat. Or you can
step up to the plate with me and take a swing for the thrill of
victory. Please join me. Because when we win in California, we're
winning for all of America.
Thank you
and God Bless,

Steve
Garvey

Republican for United States Senate

P.S. It's
the bottom of the 9th and Republicans desperately need a homerun.
We simply can't let another election slip through our fingers
while Democrats go on destroying our country. With your help, I
know we can beat Adam Schiff in California and start the
Republican Comeback Rally America needs. But the primary is in
just three months. So please rush campaign contribution of $35 or
more as soon as you can. Thank you! -Steve

BY STEVE GARVEY FOR U.S. SENATE

| | | | | _Please support this[new action](https://default.salsalabs.org/Ta8f8f362-f591-4259-97f8-1618672961ac/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) from our friends at Indivisible!_ Friends, One thing has been consistent since Elon Musk’s chaotic takeover of X, formerly known as Twitter: the promotion of hate and disinformation. Musk has allowed the return of violent white supremacists to the platform, and used his reach to spread their hate and fuel anti-trans sentiment. And he’s personally spread antisemitic conspiracy theories, scapegoating Jews for his own mismanagement of the platform. [**We can’t stand by as this billionaire lets a social media platform become a cesspool of hate and disinformation.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Ta0731f5e-8e56-4d65-af9c-230c6f664fea/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) So we’ve stepped back from X.1 And we’re urging other organizations and companies to do the same – to decrease the power of this increasingly hateful and misinformation-filled platform. **But we want to know: Do you stand with us against Elon Musk’s hateful rhetoric and continued platforming of bigotry? ** [**Add your name today, and call on companies and organizations to step back from X.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tb376b8e6-d283-4009-b013-4d26b970b1ae/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) We’ve all seen the platform worsen in every way since Musk’s takeover. More disinformation, extremist accounts in our timelines and less relevant and interesting content. But the increase in hateful posts is most alarming. It’s clear Elon Musk cares more about spreading bigoted views than running a truly democratized social media platform. [**Add your name today to call on other organizations and companies to step back from X. **](https://default.salsalabs.org/T9c54e487-60db-422c-97a9-7b0dab3fa479/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

disclaimer_text: Paid for by John Teichert for Senate]()
body:
Throughout this incredible journey, I have been continually humbled, honored, and blessed by the unwavering support | | | | |
---
**February 16, 2024**
Dear friend,
It is with a deep sense of gratitude and respect that I reach out to you today. Throughout this incredible journey, I have been continually humbled, honored, and blessed by the unwavering support you have extended to me as we pursued a shared vision to wrestle Maryland and our great nation back to where we belong.
Together, we embarked on an exhaustive campaign, rallying patriots across Maryland—from Garrett to Somerset counties, and everywhere in between. After fervent prayer and deliberation with my family and team, I have made the difficult decision to withdraw from the race. This journey, which began four and a half months ago, has been a natural extension of my lifelong commitment to support and defend the Constitution of the United States and my burning passion to guide our state and nation to where we truly belong. I am not done in my pursuits of these worthy endeavors. In fact, to some extent, I’m just getting started.
As I crisscrossed Maryland, engaging in conversations with you, hearing your stories, and feeling the pulse of our communities, I have come to the conclusion that it is not yet my time. Instead, I believe it is Governor Larry Hogan's time. Governor Hogan, a proven leader with a track record of bipartisan accomplishments, possesses the collaborative leadership style that Marylanders desperately need at this pivotal moment in our nation's history.
Although I will not be a contender in the 2024 U.S. Senate race in Maryland, I know that conservatives have the answer to our nation’s needs, and I have incredible hope that we have a strong path to victory in November and beyond. Accordingly, I am announcing my full endorsement of Governor Larry Hogan for U.S. Senate. I am channeling my time, talent, energy, and passion into fully supporting his candidacy, and I strongly urge you to join me in doing so.
I want to express my heartfelt appreciation to each one of you who has supported me during this campaign. Your dedication, encouragement, and shared commitment to our foundational principles have been truly inspiring. It is my sincere hope that we will continue working together on this journey to positively impact Maryland and the United States of America.
I also want to extend my profound gratitude to the leaders and members of the Veterans for Teichert Coalition, Law Enforcement for Teichert Coalition, Faith Leaders Coalition, and Parents for Teichert Coalition. In addition, I was deeply honored and appreciative of each endorsement. Your support and collaboration have been instrumental in our efforts to address critical issues impacting real people who are looking for leaders with real solutions.
My commitment to serving with integrity, courage, and a collaborative-conservative leadership style remains steadfast. Together, we can spark a widespread revival of our foundational principles through leadership, not politics.
With my sincerest gratitude,
John TeichertBrigadier General (ret)

body:
Maine Fisheries are under attack from NOAA. Stand with me to fight the machine that takes advantage of every tragedy to further restrict our freedoms.
| | | |

|

| **Our amazing Maine Fishermen are once again under attack!**

---
| |
---
|
---
| The recent death of the Right Whale off the coast of Cape Cod was terrible news for all Maine Fishermen. NOAA is waiting in the wings to damage the industry further with more regulations and harmful restrictions. Maine Lobstermen and Fishermen have been the shepherds and the watching eye over our oceans for generations. Lobster, Cod, Whales, Seals, and Sharks have been a protected species for many years - our fishermen are the first line of defense. The federal government simply does not want you to believe this. We need to view this incident with open eyes. Tragedies can and will happen, we can NOT cut off our nose to spite our own face. We need to stand up for our lobstermen and women. From Boothbay to Harpswell to Portland and beyond, they are the stewards of responsible treatment for our oceans and our waterways. Stand with me and the rest of the rational minds in Maine - NOAA wants to destroy our most precious industry, our fisheries. Yet another example of big government overreach.

# The Story of Kate Cox

Peter- women's rights are non-negotiable.
The ability to control decisions about our own bodies isn't just a matter of policy; it's a fundamental aspect of our humanity.
[**Be sure to watch the video below to learn about Kate Cox's story and understand why women's autonomy is of utmost importance.**](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=2f6566061a&e=a2a46ff12c)
[](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=ba41461cc8&e=a2a46ff12c)
Every person, regardless of gender, deserves the autonomy to access necessary healthcare without fear or interference.
Take the story of Kate Cox, for instance. She had to leave Texas to receive essential care, illustrating the pressing nature of this issue. Countless others like her might find themselves in similar predicaments, forced to choose between their health and the limitations of state laws.
**If elected, I promise to be a voice for women's bodily autonomy.**
I'll fight tirelessly to ensure that every woman's right to make choices about her own body is not only respected but fiercely protected.
I'm ready to champion the rights of women across the United States.
[**Let's rally for a future where every woman can make decisions about her health without hindrance**](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=3a38a7a58d&e=a2a46ff12c)**.**

**

These were the words the U.S. Marines told me when my family and I were sheltering in the U.S. embassy after American diplomats were taken hostage in Iran.

I was a little kid who had just moved to a foreign country for my father’s new job, and I was absolutely terrified

_But in that moment, for the first time in a long time, I felt safe._

_That was the exact moment I knew that when I grew up, I wanted to serve in the military._

Years later, I went on to attend the Naval Academy and serve for 25 years in Special Operations retiring as a U.S. Navy Captain. **

Serving our country has been the absolute honor of my life, and I couldn’t be more grateful for the opportunity to build a better country for my children and their peers.

_But right now, all of the hard work my fellow servicemembers and I put in is in jeopardy._

**Joe Biden is stripping the same freedoms we fought for. Conservatives are being thrown in prison. The radical Left is telling us what we have to believe - and if we refuse to go along with them, the consequences are****dire.**

I didn’t put my life on the line for our country just to watch some career politician smear our legacy. That’s why I’m not standing by idly.

**I’m running for U.S. Senate in Virginia because I believe that America is worth saving, and just like when I was in the Navy, I’ll do whatever it takes to keep our country free.**

clean_body: | | | "Nothing is going to happen to you tonight, not under our watch.” These were the words the U.S. Marines told me when my family and I were sheltering in the U.S. embassy after American diplomats were taken hostage in Iran. I was a little kid who had just moved to a foreign country for my father’s new job, and I was absolutely terrified But in that moment, for the first time in a long time, I felt safe. That was the exact moment I knew that when I grew up, I wanted to serve in the military. Years later, I went on to attend the Naval Academy and serve for 25 years in Special Operations retiring as a U.S. Navy Captain. Serving our country has been the absolute honor of my life, and I couldn’t be more grateful for the opportunity to build a better country for my children and their peers. But right now, all of the hard work my fellow servicemembers and I put in is in jeopardy. Joe Biden is stripping the same freedoms we fought for. Conservatives are being thrown in prison. The radical Left is telling us what we have to believe - and if we refuse to go along with them, the consequences aredire. I didn’t put my life on the line for our country just to watch some career politician smear our legacy. That’s why I’m not standing by idly. I’m running for U.S. Senate in Virginia because I believe that America is worth saving, and just like when I was in the Navy, I’ll do whatever it takes to keep our country free. In Liberty, CAPT Hung Cao USN (Ret) TEXT HUNG TO 21412 | | Paid for by Hung Cao for Virginia | | Use of military rank, job titles, and photographs in uniform does not imply endorsement by the Department of the Navy or the Department of Defense.

name: Demi Kouzounas
subject: I want to introduce myself
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Demi for Senate
body:
I grew up in Saco, Maine, in a large Greek family and was raised by hard-working immigrant parents.

| |
---
| | | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zad62smii13s5ja2j444sr5cvh48ufp0e4tmk7f0_rp22sh2s8i6eo30shi60o31clh2bs)
---
Friend,
My name is Demi Kouzounas, and I wanted to tell you a little about myself and why I'm running for the U.S. Senate in Maine.

I grew up in Saco, Maine, in a large Greek family and was raised by hard-working immigrant parents. Because of them, I was taught the values of honesty, integrity, and dedication. My parent's home was filled with respect, pride, and love for our country, which is something that I still live by today.

---
| [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zkss8713rl5i0n6c1pcqdt8r6d3gbbptitn6iq88_rp22sh2s8i6eo30shi60o31clh2bs)
---

I went on to be the first member of my family to attend college, and graduated from Tufts University, earning a Doctorate in Dentistry. From there, I decided to take a leap of faith by serving our country in the U.S. Army, where I was stationed overseas in Germany with my husband.

---
| [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2ze3cni64egfi3njr4cj6mpsrdcucaqvssu3fpi70_rp22sh2s8i6eo30shi60o31clh2bs)
---

After years in the service, my husband and I settled down to open dental practices around my home state to provide dental care for all Mainers. I wanted to serve our country in a different way which led me to co-found Dentists Who Care for Maine and started Bright Smiles, allowing those to receive dental care and no cost to them!

Maine was just the beginning, though, I traveled nine times to the Dominican Republic to provide life-changing dental care to many families in need.

---
| [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z2q0tn1st62c67g2bsoo166ka3iqv7njsa0c77j0_rp22sh2s8i6eo30shi60o31clh2bs)
---

Along our journey, my husband and I were blessed to have two children, and now we have three beautiful grandchildren!

---
| [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z0hfprh5fnut7p8807hvl5i0osbh7bjsqdu98co8_rp22sh2s8i6eo30shi60o31clh2bs)
---

This was still not enough for me! I wanted to help Maine even more, which is why I got into politics. I proudly served as the Chairwoman for the Maine GOP for three terms. Under my role, I forged many national relationships and put Maine BACK ON the map for Republican politics!

---
| [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z7tfturis9egfdc383vjd185ejjjd2aukk7nhnbg_rp22sh2s8i6eo30shi60o31clh2bs)
---

Now, I am taking on a new challenge. I'm running for U.S. Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Angus King.

I will take the same fight and spirit I've shown throughout my life to help Maine families have a better life. More than ever, Maine needs a voice to find solutions to their unique problems.

---
| [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zvtrkn4eea01v6340ljsu5vadmkq7our9p12upi8_rp22sh2s8i6eo30shi60o31clh2bs)
---

My journey started in Maine and grew beyond. I look forward to the next chapter of my journey in the halls of the United States Capitol.

Please, make my next photo in this story to be of us winning this race with my family by my side.

**[We can't do that without your help, though. So please, Friend, can you chip in any amount to help kick start my campaign and flip Maine RED in November?](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z2grk4jl64aegeq18cka72uoh24il3g80sl9vcvo_rp22sh2s8i6eo30shi60o31clh2bs "We can’t do that without your help, though. So please, Friend, can you chip in any amount to help kick start my campaign and flip Maine RED in November?")**

---
| | [DONATE TO DEMI](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zj10qqlljkf6ek4b56r1dlfgnvpmiptioi5ch430_rp22sh2s8i6eo30shi60o31clh2bs)
---

---

I know with your support, we can win this. Thank you for your time reading this.

Sincerely,

Demi Kouzounas
Candidate for U.S Senate

Kyrsten Sinema and Democrat Ruben Gallego. We can win all five of these elections -- and we risk losing even one of them. I'm asking you to split a donation between of these races. It will immediately be used to invest in victory come November. As I've said before, if we lose in 2024, we're done. But if we take back the White House, keep the House, and flip the Senate, we'll have a chance to make America strong again. We have a plan to stop the Marxist Left in its tracks. name: Shamaine Daniels
subject: BIG NEWS - We just received an important national endorsement!
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023?refcode=LV [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023?refcode=LV]
Dear Friend,
I'm writing today to share some big news! I'm one of the first candidates to be endorsed by the Latino Victory Fund as part of their "First Latinas" campaign! I am pleased and proud to accept this important national endorsement.
Latino Victory is an organization dedicated to building political power in the Latino community so that the voices and values of Latinos are reflected at every level of government and in the policies that drive our country forward. Here is what Latino Victory had to say when they announced my endorsement:
Today, we are re-launching our First Latinas campaign–an effort to increase Latina representation in elected office– with endorsements of two historic candidates.
Shamaine Daniels stands to become the first Latina to represent Pennsylvania in Congress. Shamaine is s a champion for working families and an advocate for workers’ rights and civil rights and will be a powerful voice in Congress. We are thrilled to endorse her.
Join the Latino Victory Fund in their support for my campaign by making a contribution today! CLICK HERE to donate now. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023?refcode=LV]
I am especially proud to accept this endorsement because I believe that a diversity of voices is important among our elected leaders. As a first generation Venezuelan immigrant, I represent the promise of the American Dream, and I'm running for Congress to ensure that the opportunity to realize that dream remains a reality for every American.
Protecting that opportunity means electing leaders who understand the barriers that so many, from EVERY type of background, face when striving to build a better a life. It also means defeating so called "leaders," like Scott Perry, who are a threat not just to the American Dream, but to our Democracy itself.
PA-10 is a diverse district, and defeating Scott Perry is going to require a coalition of voters that reflect that diversity, and who share our common values. The Latino Victory Fund joins the National Organization for Women (NOW) in endorsing our campaign, and I couldn't be more proud! These endorsement demonstrates that I am building that coalition, in PA-10 and nationally, and I am the only Democratic candidate in PA-10 who can do so.
In Congress, I will continue the work to which I have dedicated my career - to be a voice for those who have none, and to fight for policies that mean more and better opportunities for every American to build a better life. Today, I'm asking you to join our coalition as we fight for those shared values by making a contribution today. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023?refcode=LV]
Thank you in advance for your support. Protecting and nurturing the promise of the American Dream is something we can only accomplish together.
With Gratitude,
Shamaine

body:
I am running for Congress to represent TX-15.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/79121817/455511417/-1345170518?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDUzMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyZTVjMjUyOC1kNmNjLWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=XREPtMKkwOJBwwpgbcorFDnDG_Ync5oD-t5g9-YocQs=&emci=552cf663-f8ab-ee11-bea1-0022482237da&emdi=2e5c2528-d6cc-ee11-85f9-002248223794&ceid=19448623)
Hola Peter, I am running for Congress to represent TX-15.
In just a bit, I’m going to ask you to become a founding donor to our campaign. But first, I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I’m jumping into this race.
I come from a big family of immigrants, farm workers and entrepreneurs. My parents, immigrants who made their way to the Rio Grande Valley from Mexico, did a little bit of everything to make ends meet. But running Pulga (flea market) Los Portales, serving thousands of our community members on a weekly basis and helping dozens of working-class entrepreneurs start their businesses, defined my family's values — our South Texan values.
But my life changed forever when I was in college. While at Columbia University, after years of fighting multiple sclerosis, my mother took her last breath at just 46 years old. It was then I decided the best way to honor her legacy is to fight for a better future for my family.
To fight for a better future for ALL of us — including you, Peter.
Every day, I see how hard the people of South Texas work just to scrape by. At our family’s pulga, dozens of vendors come each week, hoping to make enough to put food on the table. They are the overlooked emprendedores who make our community strong.
I’m working for stronger and healthier neighborhoods in TX-15 and I have a plan to make this happen.
It starts with fighting for quality affordable healthcare, protecting workers, providing good-paying jobs and a thriving economy, protecting women’s reproductive rights — and that’s just the beginning.
**[But to accomplish all of this, I need your help to jumpstart this campaign and put us in the best possible position as we launch this campaign. Can you make a contribution and become a founding donor today? What we are able to raise in these early days will be our first chance to show the state — and our opponents — just how much grassroots power we have.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/79121818/455511418/1640391652?refcode=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDUzMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyZTVjMjUyOC1kNmNjLWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=XREPtMKkwOJBwwpgbcorFDnDG_Ync5oD-t5g9-YocQs=)**
**[Become a founding donor](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/79121819/455511419/1640391652?refcode=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDUzMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyZTVjMjUyOC1kNmNjLWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=XREPtMKkwOJBwwpgbcorFDnDG_Ync5oD-t5g9-YocQs=)**
We’re at a critical moment for the future of South Texas. In South Texas, Monica De La Cruz makes a lot of promises to us, la gente. But in Congress, her record tells a different story. Her budget bill makes devastating cuts, from slashing veterans’ health care to taking away millions from our schools, and even jeopardizing Medicare and Social Security.
What’s more, she’d let the government interfere in women’s private medical decisions and take away our freedoms.
She wants to distract us with extremist issues in hopes that we won’t notice how badly her policies are hurting our communities. And, more importantly, so that we won’t notice how powerful we can be if we all come together to fight for a better world.
South Texas needs an advocate — no a una politica vendida.
I’m not afraid of the fight ahead because I’ve been underestimated and questioned before. Time and time again while growing up, I dealt with questions about why I spoke Spanglish, or why I mixed English and Spanish, about how I wore my curly hair and whether it looked too frizzy or if it was professional enough.
But instead of letting that change me, I chose to proudly represent my roots through my education and work. It’s why I decided to return to the Rio Grande Valley and get to work.
And it’s something I’ll continue in this fight to become your next Congresswoman of TX-15.
¡Vamos Por Quince!
Michelle Vallejo

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Remember a few years ago when the DCCC (House Democrats’ fundraising arm)
blacklisted anyone working to support progressive candidates challenging
moderate, anti-choice incumbents in the Democratic primaries?

When everyday working-class people were challenging corporate-backed
incumbents, the DCCC made an entire blacklist to prevent our party from
looking more like the people that elect them.

Now, as AIPAC threatens to spend $100 million against progressive
Democratic incumbents with Republican megadonor support, the DCCC is
silent.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240216.i3qz06&refcode=em20240216-33348&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=3&t=1001&akid=33348%2E1203867%2Enml8DO ]We’re pulling out all the stops to go up against this GOP-funded
outside group and re-elect every Squad member in 2024: chip in now to fuel
our fight.

AIPAC is building a war chest worth tens of millions of dollars largely
funded by millionaires, billionaires, and right-wing extremists who also
contribute to the likes of Donald Trump, Nikki Haley, and other GOP
candidates.

The right-wing backed, anti-Palestinian lobby group has “publicly declared
war on progressive congressmembers” and is planning to spend big money to
unseat them in this year’s primary elections.

Just look at New York’s 16th district, where AIPAC is the single-largest
donor to Jamaal Bowman’s moderate challenger, George Latimer. He received
$600,000 from AIPAC after they hand-picked him to run against Jamaal.
Latimer is also using anti-union consultant Global Strategy Group (GSG)
for polling support.

As The American Prospect noted, “GSG taking on Latimer as a client shows
that the Democratic Party’s top corporate consultants are willing to help
unseat Democratic incumbents—a strategy that progressives were excoriated
for just a few years ago by the very same people when the dynamic was
reversed.

Apparently, it’s okay to challenge Democratic incumbents when they’re
pro-peace progressives, just not when they’re corporate-backed
establishment Democrats.

It goes to show that we can’t sit back and rely on the Democratic
establishment to protect Squad incumbents like Jamaal, Cori, Ilhan, and
Rashida. That’s where you come in.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240216.i3qz06&refcode=em20240216-33348&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=3&t=1002&akid=33348%2E1203867%2Enml8DO ]If you can afford to, please pitch in $3 or more to
directly support Justice Democrats’ work to re-elect the Squad and stop
AIPAC’s right-wing infiltration of our Democratic primaries in 2024 →

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240216.i3qz06&refcode=em20240216-33348&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=3&t=1021&akid=33348%2E1203867%2Enml8DO ]Contribute $3

If the Democratic Party truly cares about protecting incumbents who fight
for our shared values and democracy, they would create an AIPAC blacklist
and demand candidates stop taking their right-wing megadonor money.

We won’t hold our breath. Instead, we’re going to keep building the
resources necessary to fight back and protect our young, diverse,
working-class bloc of leaders committed to creating progressive change for
the people.

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that
this is a difficult time.

There are other ways to make an impact in support of peace and equality in
Israel and Palestine: please urge your member of Congress to support a
ceasefire through [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/139873?t=1022&akid=33348%2E1203867%2Enml8DO ]Adalah Justice Project’s petition or by calling them
using [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/139874?t=1023&akid=33348%2E1203867%2Enml8DO ]Jewish Voice for Peace’s dialer here. Your voice matters in this
critical moment.

Hi there, Peter. It’s Quentin James and Stefanie Brown James, the husband-and-wife team behind The Collective PAC, which has been dedicated to supporting and funding Black candidates on the local, state, and federal levels and engaging Black voters in the political process since 2016.

In the last three years, we’ve provided over 100,000 free rideshares to and from the polls, registered over 200,000 voters, and made nearly 5 million voter contact attempts.

That translates into success ▶️ **_we’ve helped elect over 350 Black candidates to local, state and federal office._**

But here’s the thing: _**Our success relies on grassroots supporters like you, Peter.**_

[We need to raise $50,000 in February alone if we're going to continue this important work in 2024. That’s why we’re reaching out to ask if you’ll make a gift of $10 to The Collective PAC this Black History Month.
