Derek,

Earlier this week, I took the debate stage for the second time to show
Californians why I have the experience and track record to earn their vote
for the U.S. Senate. [ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/2907?c0=feb2024_abs_em.sAcFHC&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC30_20240216_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=5525%2E5257348%2E_oTA9v ]Before I share my thoughts, can you chip in any
amount to my Senate campaign to show your support? This election is in 18
days, and Californians are voting right now.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/2907?c0=feb2024_abs_em.sAcFHC&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC30_20240216_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1005&akid=5525%2E5257348%2E_oTA9v ]DONATE

On Monday night, I shared with the voters why I believe I am the best
candidate to address the housing crisis, build an economy that works for
everyone, and make our democracy work for California and our country.

I shared a story about a young woman struggling with rising housing costs,
student loans, and healthcare costs.

My parents were able to support our family and purchase a home that
matched my father’s annual salary — as a traveling salesman — of $18,000,
which would be unimaginable in today’s economy. We need to change that.

If I have the honor to represent California in the U.S. Senate, I will
continue the work I’ve done in the House to address the affordability
crisis so that future generations can afford to live here. I will work
hard to ensure that California has the resources necessary to overcome
these challenges and create an economy that works for all.

Californians deserve a senator who will fight for them and address their
issues day in and day out. That's why I need your help to propel our
grassroots funded campaign to the general election in November.

| Did you see the State of the State on Wednesday? Here’s what I saw:

**The governor claimed that the state of our state is strong. It may be for some, but too many Granite Staters have been left out and left behind.**

We live in the greatest state in the nation, but there are real challenges that have been neglected for far too long and must be solved. That’s why I’m in this race to take back the corner office.

_This November, we can choose to live in a state where everyone has the right to vote.

We can choose to live in a state where every woman can make her own reproductive health care decisions.

We can live in a state where everyone can love who they love and be who they are.

We can live in a state where teachers can teach – the truth – and students can learn.

We can live in a state where we have the freedom to breathe clean air and drink clean water.

We can live in a state where working families can afford to put a roof over their families’ heads, feed their children, clothe them, give them a good education, and retire with dignity. _

Friends,
Calvin Coolidge once said, "It is much more important to kill bad bills than to pass good ones."
That is a very wise adage. Once a government program becomes law of the land, it will expand and metastasize. It becomes impossible to kill, while enabling and emboldening lobbyists to push for similar bills that benefit the interests of their crony clients.
It's a cycle that all feeds on itself.
So it was refreshing when the Wyoming Freedom Caucus killed 13 big government bills **on the first day of session earlier this week**. From [a local news report](https://substack.com/redirect/2ba40e62-d2ff-4a5b-8bb6-4156a9037cb1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> "The Wyoming Freedom Caucus and our allies in the House of Representatives defeated 1⁄3 of the policy bills that were presented for introduction [Monday]," Freedom Caucus Chairman Rep. John Bear (R-Gillette) wrote to WyoFile in a statement.
> While the hard-line Freedom Caucus does not have the majority in the House, it does possess enough members to block bills on introduction during a budget session when two-thirds support is needed.
> That power was on full display Monday.
> "This action was an illustration of the growing movement to both curb government spending and bring government policy more in line with conservative values," Bear wrote.
Some of the bad bills included fee increases, Orwellian restrictions on protected speech, and a fake "school choice" bill that would create a whole new government-run Pre-K program.
Despite this fantastic news, there is still a LOT of work to be done to expose the liberal Republicans who control the Wyoming legislature. During this same week, a WYFC-sponsored bill to stop the COVID madness failed to pass the WY House:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/095d0271-a3f1-4b49-969c-508797eb0c45?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
If that wasn't offensive enough, these same liberal Republicans also rejected a "What is a Woman" bill, creating biological definitions for male and female, sponsored by WYFC member Rep. Jeanette Ward.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/cba7263f-d20c-445c-816e-93279c64e031?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Wyoming is suppose to be one of the reddest states in the country. Donald Trump won it in 2020 by a greater percentage than any other state. But Democrats and liberal Republicans in Cheyenne are rejecting common sense legislation.
There is so much more work to be done to fix our states. Please help us continue to support and educate state Freedom Caucuses like Wyoming and elsewhere as they take on the Uniparty in the state capitols all across the country.
[DONATE](https://substack.com/redirect/3543c31e-8160-434e-9acd-4efc1f7dcf35?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**IDAHO**
Last week, the U.S. Senate passed an unfunded $96 billion bill that sends more of our money overseas in the form of "foreign aid" instead of using that money to reduce our national debt or secure our border. Our Idaho Freedom Caucus publicly called out their US Senators who supported the deal:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/472092af-b3bf-44d4-a0ea-a0b07838b555?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Also, in Idaho, special interest groups and their water-carriers in the legislature tried to push a bill through the Idaho Senate that would have granted some legal immunity to manufacturers of pesticides like Bayer's Round-Up.
Democrats - in a brief moment of sanity - opposed the bill along with the Idaho Freedom Caucus and allied conservative lawmakers. In the end, they defeated the bill! Unlike their Big Pharma colleagues who helped shove immunity protection through Congress on the COVID vaccines, Bayer simply couldn't buy off enough votes to get this passed. Big win against crony capitalism! Here's a tweet from IDFC member Sen. Scott Herndon, who was heavily lobbied by Big Ag:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/52738d1c-afb9-4280-94b4-36c1098d2445?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Keep fighting,**

**Andy Roth**

Six years ago, I was dropping my oldest daughter off at kindergarten when I saw an armed police officer patrolling the drop off-line. It was just days after the tragic shooting at Marjory Stoneman Douglas High School in Parkland, Florida where 17 students’ and staff members’ lives were stolen in a horrific mass shooting.

Then, I saw my oldest baby get out of the car with her bright pink unicorn backpack on and walk into her elementary school none the wiser...She had no idea how profoundly the adults in this country had failed her, to the point that she might not be safe in her classroom.

Listen, when this terrible tragedy happened six years ago, I was engaged in politics enough to be a registered voter and to have the numbers of my Senators and Representative in my phone. But my advocacy didn’t extend beyond leaving voicemails in their offices.

As a pediatrician and a mother, I could not stay silent. Imagine caring for a 3 year old, beautiful little girl, whose face is permanently disfigured due to an unintentional gunshot wound that could have been prevented with a secure storage law. Or a 17 year old boy who is now paralyzed from his second gunshot wound that could have been prevented with federal funding for hospital-based violence intervention programs that address the root causes of community gun violence.

I believe we have a moral imperative to act and I am done waiting for our elected officials to do the right thing. The solutions are not extreme or controversial - they are common sense. And they are supported by a vast majority of Americans.

**_There are no more excuses._**

So if our elected officials refuse to act to protect our children, our only recourse is to replace them with leaders who will. That’s what Their Future PAC is all about.

Today I will continue to honor the lives stolen six years ago at Marjory Stoneman Douglas High School with my action. **_[Please join me in building a safer future for our children.](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953z3011QGjayrd2kzpmP2c9jFmgc4o5AoO4mOxE6fIOhgMos8lurcnyRJ0C5FAx0SeAftIB_WN88uSB95w81055t2IJGXd_kaY9gTuJIFh-o_jp3eOKKyWrRtn74JxNEAL4bhwGja2FBaU620jR6FQAUxGRfzbLzQEMwef8GkGkYtP8s2GCQlInlmgujVNxt3ZfRdKH4XkC90fv4HaNRzGNPfJfy9-Ly2ZJ4aJt9IOSc-Pzfr3CIBUovTuew4cRkxW1nTHmpWApUWFzt0AGQT6BTmcW-6daesELZNeFLbRWZ5iX258GlwCedkeyz24mwA3V_uPvhtjLu_qovn11PYKDdMsfQkn2c4y7n_5ZVZQ3EkBFOQe4zJHDcH5oXbiMMh1mb4gS_BEaQiiaMzT47QZfF/43w/y66dWS0-RSS66PDDgKW2-A/h6/YrqndxIZbXTJqy7G532kcwqdANZG4-_UkhhEMwMxppg)_**

---
|
---
|
---
| My bill SB 603 to give incarcerated pregnant women preferential treatment for drug rehab programs has passed the Senate uncontested and is headed to the House. I have visited the women's jail in Goochland County and I've heard reports around the district about the challenges faced by pregnant women in jail to attend drug rehab programs. Incarcerated pregnant women (those held in federal or state prisons, jails, or juvenile detention facilities) make up one of the most vulnerable segments of society, with higher rates of mental illness, drug addiction, and histories of trauma than incarcerated men. This bill will create a work group to find answers on how to help rehabilitate young and not so young women with the triple threat of being incarcerated, being pregnant, and being addicted.

I have visited the women's jail in Goochland County and I've heard reports around the district about the challenges faced by pregnant women in jail to attend drug rehab programs. Incarcerated pregnant women (those held in federal or state prisons, jails, or juvenile detention facilities) make up one of the most vulnerable segments of society, with higher rates of mental illness, drug addiction, and histories of trauma than incarcerated men. #

Friends -
We’re willing to bet that when you woke up this morning, you probably didn’t think you’d be making your first online contribution to GIFFORDS PAC.
But today we’re asking you if you can do just that.
[**If you already know that you’re able to give today, please use this link to make a contribution.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-feb24.CYoP11&refcode=em240216-1-30&t=1&akid=7663%2E3935704%2ErYNi96)

Our preparations to hold our gun safety Senate majority and elect gun safety champions at all levels of government in 2024 are well underway. Earlier this week, we helped gain one seat in the House! But we have to raise a lot to help elect new leaders and beat the NRA’s hold on our Congress.
As we still reel from the horrific act of violence that took place in Kansas City this Wednesday, it’s more important than ever for us to keep moving forward in our mission to end gun violence. States like Missouri have some of the weakest gun laws in the country—and some of the highest rates of gun violence. We need safer gun laws in every state and at the federal level. It’s up to us to change the status quo.
Make no mistake: our work during the past eleven years has changed hearts, minds, and laws. But this work is far from over. We must keep fighting.

Friend,

This week, the world watched in horror as Israel executed a series of airstrikes in Rafah, a city on the southern edge of the Gaza Strip where 1.4 million Palestinians have fled to escape ongoing fighting in the region.

President Biden has warned Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu [https://apnews.com/article/israel-hamas-war-news-02-11-2014-785309c668e15728c6aac9905f290b4d#:~:text=RAFAH, Gaza Strip (AP),-month Israel-Hamas war.] not to conduct military operations against Hamas in Rafah without a “credible and executable” plan to protect civilians. We need a permanent ceasefire, for Hamas to release all hostages, and start negotiations for an independent Palestinian state with equal rights living side by side with a secure Israel.

**[Can I count on you to chip in $3 to boost my outreach efforts? Every gift – even $1 – will ensure my campaign is fully funded and able to engage with the voters that could determine this race.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/79151455/455590387/1033648996?refcode=em-2.16.24-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDU2NTciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYjY3Yzg2MjEtZjVjYy1lZTExLTg1ZjktMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=OOtNreyhTEcV6wRs1GRP7J4IT16BlpXEMlwSOntMSCU=)**

From voters who believe in my vision to those who are undecided, it is imperative that I am able to reach our Orange County neighbors and rally them to our cause.

**We can’t afford to let CA-47 turn red – and that is what is at stake if we fail to get voters to the polls by March 5th.** Experts have told us we must hold on to this seat if we want any hope to win the House majority.

But keeping CA-47 blue means even more to me than ensuring Democrats gain back control. This race is about Orange County and what we as a community stands for.

Do we stand for a better economy for everyone and not the few?
Do we stand for women’s reproductive rights?
Do we stand for democracy?
**Or will we stand by while extremists like my GOP opponent Scott Baugh take control?**

Friend,

How anybody could vote for this man is beyond me. We must defeat him in November and expel him from politics forever. That should be the sole goal of all patriotic Americans.
I’m grateful to have your support on this mission. Together, we will defeat Trump and protect our democracy.

Sarah Longwell

body:
I grew up in Saco, Maine, in a large Greek family and was raised by hard-working immigrant parents.

| |
---
| | | | [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=1582843f21a34741b9ab5b0782ce5ad7&_e=5Bhcoz06rf5BfNWHLZ-bSfeNblXbXSj04FhS8oSAi93PGa5l3sDaahsoD8M8NqW4QRBqhpnQtUoyyjRfotl4684cz9F4-CwvSIq-wdtjCKGUcaekSgMjPtkUoPx0HzEGiORF8eNwV5-YuLbU9kIjoWL2PBQ3B3qi3tRzz7yEaIj4KcMrSWZJqOvy1MTjHAFhgojOQ85YttP2XHceo-iZbjposjXjhielHXsWtXqE3O5ZVJLlhVd9eZh9KVl0r3wZEaHqd8fCdBIp2binkysPycjA8tdOpZi7W1W3CA9ZCV_UJPHQAmrLvrKghhWmhqHB4YLHvtRIYiHfoywRnV6T4Y6dUGjsSniVb9KyTO88ZtxUvQ6cUINSYXSDJY7REIo_nU2n1MD_nODjH1Oj35-7yCvCQM9VJSFp8yDvubKm_sxUbmZXoEi5xV1foTQLzBLVr5s-LhOby9dznC-umggRqg%3D%3D)
---
Friend,
My name is Demi Kouzounas, and I wanted to tell you a little about myself and why I'm running for the U.S. Senate in Maine.

I grew up in Saco, Maine, in a large Greek family and was raised by hard-working immigrant parents. Because of them, I was taught the values of honesty, integrity, and dedication. My parent's home was filled with respect, pride, and love for our country, which is something that I still live by today.

---
| [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=1582843f21a34741b9ab5b0782ce5ad7&_e=5Bhcoz06rf5BfNWHLZ-bSfeNblXbXSj04FhS8oSAi93PGa5l3sDaahsoD8M8NqW4QRBqhpnQtUoyyjRfotl4684cz9F4-CwvSIq-wdtjCKGUcaekSgMjPtkUoPx0HzEGiORF8eNwV5-YuLbU9kIjoWL2PBQ3B3qi3tRzz7yEaIj4KcMrSWZJqOvy1MTjHAFhgojOQ85YttP2XHceo-iZbjposjXjhielHXsWtXqE3O5ZVJLlhVd9eZh9KVl0r3wZEaHqd8fCdBIp2binkysPycjA8tdOpZi7W1W3CA9ZCV_UJPHQAmrLvrKghhWmhqHB9iUObDvGMIk2uBJfktPPvchZUcqp04HYjvSMHUMyfHoyfSDNiKSSa9x2JXQZhxGU2qRDbfLYqlPcX78QiIj33_CpPfWfUrizdWzQpywFJqcDaKxBbnQU5WDeT0O8DG5l9LUKVNOzItUO0CX2aMFGIA%3D%3D)
---

I went on to be the first member of my family to attend college, and graduated from Tufts University, earning a Doctorate in Dentistry. From there, I decided to take a leap of faith by serving our country in the U.S. Army, where I was stationed overseas in Germany with my husband.

---
| [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=1582843f21a34741b9ab5b0782ce5ad7&_e=5Bhcoz06rf5BfNWHLZ-bSfeNblXbXSj04FhS8oSAi93PGa5l3sDaahsoD8M8NqW4QRBqhpnQtUoyyjRfotl4684cz9F4-CwvSIq-wdtjCKGUcaekSgMjPtkUoPx0HzEGiORF8eNwV5-YuLbU9kIjoWL2PBQ3B3qi3tRzz7yEaIj4KcMrSWZJqOvy1MTjHAFhgojOQ85YttP2XHceo-iZbjposjXjhielHXsWtXqE3O5ZVJLlhVd9eZh9KVl0r3wZEaHqd8fCdBIp2binkysPycjA8tdOpZi7W1W3CA9ZCV_UJPHQAmrLvrKghhWmhqHBZY8jaTDzP2G6-NwwXS5DXhPHNcEaUjAYWFUikvjEQIktXi17lerD06FDmy8pPx7cwmt15EHwCCcffQ3nX6FCb6b4j49uNLV8ETUPJaaZfEm8bSxs5qEm1NnNvMLT0gQ0afqYECYqzr_IovKlGXMdIA%3D%3D)
---

After years in the service, my husband and I settled down to open dental practices around my home state to provide dental care for all Mainers. I wanted to serve our country in a different way which led me to co-found Dentists Who Care for Maine and started Bright Smiles, allowing those to receive dental care and no cost to them!

Maine was just the beginning, though, I traveled nine times to the Dominican Republic to provide life-changing dental care to many families in need.

---
| [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=1582843f21a34741b9ab5b0782ce5ad7&_e=5Bhcoz06rf5BfNWHLZ-bSfeNblXbXSj04FhS8oSAi93PGa5l3sDaahsoD8M8NqW4QRBqhpnQtUoyyjRfotl4684cz9F4-CwvSIq-wdtjCKGUcaekSgMjPtkUoPx0HzEGiORF8eNwV5-YuLbU9kIjoWL2PBQ3B3qi3tRzz7yEaIj4KcMrSWZJqOvy1MTjHAFhgojOQ85YttP2XHceo-iZbjposjXjhielHXsWtXqE3O5ZVJLlhVd9eZh9KVl0r3wZEaHqd8fCdBIp2binkysPycjA8tdOpZi7W1W3CA9ZCV_UJPHQAmrLvrKghhWmhqHBobQnJUBJN65ch3z1L39fQwhrfqbQwjN4hHAWVbeCBqr9xqAemvzLN3lSw7OsP5dnwTZRreZSzeBCJSbWMqkAQTKGUAXMyA-lC3APBIaxRdNcCGKlGaWLDzZ8Jp5jri-mTYDyZsO3mN-WyfXJsByDIA%3D%3D)
---

Fellow American,

My mom was a schoolteacher growing up. Every single day she got up and went to educate the next generation of leaders... and she always told me, _**"Nothing will work unless you do".**_

And it is exactly what I’ve been doing since I was 17 when I dropped out of high school and started waitressing at the local Waffle House to put food on the table.

Like a lot of Americans, I struggled to make ends meet, living paycheck to paycheck as I also earned my high school diploma by taking classes at a technical college. I got by without government handouts or radical socialist policies – and I am a better woman because of it.

**Well, Fellow American, I took those same ideals I learned as a Waffle House waitress to Congress. I refuse to waiver to what anyone wants other than the constituents I was elected by,_even if it means pissing off some party members along the way._**

You should be able to go to ... a parade ... a house of worship ... a movie ... school ... the grocery store... without getting shot in America. But we know that's not the case right now. **Despite over 800 police officers being present, at least 22 people were injured – half of them kids – and 1 woman died on Wednesday when a mass shooting broke out at the Super Bowl parade in Kansas City.** And I want to be absolutely clear on why: Because last June, Brian Fitzpatrick single-handedly blocked wildly popular gun safety legislation – universal background checks and restoring the assault weapons ban – that would save lives. Local officials can only do so much. Police officers can only do so much. We all can only do so much when guns are _so easy_ to access. I used guns in the Army. I know all too well the damage they can cause. And it's why I am committed to stopping the bloodshed in our streets by defeating Brian Fitzpatrick so we can pass the commonsense gun safety laws we desperately need. It doesn't have to be like this. But nothing will change if we don't replace politicians like Fitzpatrick who don't have the courage to stand up to the NRA. Today, we mourn with the people of Kansas City. Tomorrow, we fight like hell for the laws we need to stop another city, school, and place of worship from becoming synonymous with a mass shooting. Thanks for being in this fight with me, Ashley 🚁 | | Ashley Ehasz is a U.S. Army veteran, Apache helicopter pilot, and proudly pro-choice Democrat running to unseat Republican Brian Fitzpatrick and represent Pennsylvania’s 1st Congressional District to defend our democracy, restore reproductive rights, tackle corporate greed, advocate for bold gun safety measures, and fight for working families across southeast PA.

Hi, Friend.
My name is Dani Revord. I hail from Iron Mountain, and I'm excited to announce that I've recently taken a position with Dr. Bob Lorinser's Campaign for US Congress in Michigan's 1st District.
I wanted to introduce myself to you today. I'm grateful to be named Bob's political director. I can't wait to galvanize our communities and rally behind a great candidate.
After spending over a decade in the Greater Kansas City area, I'm back in Iron Mountain and eager to do my part to help Democrats up and down the ballot in Northern Michigan and the UP.
My Background
I studied marketing at Michigan Technological University and have been in politics since 2018, serving in numerous US Senate and US House statewide and local elections.
I am giving back at MTU as the Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Advisor for the Epsilon Lambda chapter of Delta Phi Epsilon.
I love spending time with my family and my two rescue dogs. I'm also passionate about gardening and basketball.
I started working in politics as a volunteer licking envelopes in the early '90s and have remained involved in several ways ever since. I hope to bring a depth and breadth of experience to the team.
I am so excited about Bob's campaign because this moment in our nation is profound, it requires serious leadership, experience, and knowledge.
Dr. Bob is the best candidate in this race, and to flip Michigan's 1st District, we need a uniter.
Doc is the right person to bring us together, and your contributions are helping us [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob] expand our team. Grassroots donations allow me to work on my life's passion - electing great leaders who can create positive change in our communities.
I look forward to talking to you throughout the campaign. Please feel free to reach out to me, I'm happy to help.

My great-great grandfather traveled west on a wagon train in search of gold, stopped a few miles short, and settled here to start a peach farm. From a young age, I was taught the value of helping others. My parents met on a mission trip and my childhood was full of volunteering in my community. [DONATE NOW TO SUPPORT JOSH](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/79157421/455610447/1770708251?&refcode=E7051-20240216-CowboyHat-SB-CampaignNews&amount=25&refcode2=b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDMxMTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYTU3ZjU0NzktZmVjYy1lZTExLTg1ZjktMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=tS3d5iGdrxC8QW3V_7rGa8XX9BvvsvTad59jxsZEfQg=) As I got older, I delivered newspapers, graduated high school and worked my way through college at Stanford. Then I went on to make a career helping small businesses grow and eventually taught business at our local junior college. Six years ago I won a surprise victory to bring those values with me to Congress. Since then, I have thrown my heart and soul into legislation to support families like mine - families who care about their kids, their neighborhood and our country’s future. Even as the political environment gets more divisive, I try to remind myself of this kid in the cowboy hat. How passionate he was about helping, and how he believed people ultimately were good to one another. I share this to remind you that no matter how frustrated you are, I’m grateful for the opportunity you’ve given me to make a bit of a difference. clean_body: Embarrassing photo time | = | Peter, I want to tell you a little bit about this kid in the cowboy hat. (For starters, I’m aware that fashion trends have changed.) = My family came to California’s Central Valley five generations ago. My great-great grandfather traveled west on a wagon train in search of gold, stopped a few miles short, and settled here to start a peach farm. From a young age, I was taught the value of helping others. My parents met on a mission trip and my childhood was full of volunteering in my community. = As I got older, I delivered newspapers, graduated high school and worked my way through college at Stanford. Then I went on to make a career helping small businesses grow and eventually taught business at our local junior college. Six years ago I won a surprise victory to bring those values with me to Congress. Since then, I have thrown my heart and soul into legislation to support families like mine - families who care about their kids, their neighborhood and our country’s future. Even as the political environment gets more divisive, I try to remind myself of this kid in the cowboy hat. How passionate he was about helping, and how he believed people ultimately were good to one another. I share this to remind you that no matter how frustrated you are, I’m grateful for the opportunity you’ve given me to make a bit of a difference. I do this work because I believe we can still make our country better. I’m not giving up, and I hope you won’t either. = If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your payment will go through immediately: | = | = ---|--- = | = ---|--- = | = ---|--- \- Josh *

Derek —

During Monday night’s debate, Steve Garvey made an alarming remark about
what he perceives to be the greatest threat to our democracy.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/2907?c0=feb2024_abs_em.sAcFHC&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC30_20240216_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=5539%2E5257348%2EBXpH2W ]Before I get into it, will you pitch in to my campaign to make sure we
defeat Garvey and his Republican extremism once and for all?

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/2907?c0=feb2024_abs_em.sAcFHC&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC30_20240216_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1005&akid=5539%2E5257348%2EBXpH2W ]DONATE

Steve Garvey claimed that the greatest threat to our democracy is
“deconstruction of the Constitution. Packing the court. Doing away with
the filibuster.”

My thoughts? That’s rich coming from someone who supported Donald Trump
twice and would fall in line with Republican Senators like Mitch
McConnell, Ted Cruz, and Lindsey Graham supporting the Trump agenda.

Derek, the
single greatest threat to our democracy is the twice-impeached, criminally
indicted former President who incited an insurrection on our Capitol. This
isn’t a difficult question to answer.

Donald Trump packed the Supreme Court with three far-right justices, with
the help of Mitch McConnell.

As I pointed out to Garvey on the debate stage, this is why millions of
Americans lost their right to reproductive freedom. Why air and water
quality regulations are being struck down. Why voting rights are being
stripped away. Why states with common sense gun safety laws are seeing the
Supreme Court strike them down.

Protecting our democracy means restoring power to voters, not further
empowering reactionary justices appointed by Donald Trump.

I have bold plans to fix what is broken on the Supreme Court. To restore
the balance of the court. To institute term limits and establish a code of
ethics for justices.

To fix our democracy after Donald Trump bent and broke the rules to get
his way, we need a Senator who has the plans and the experience to defend
our Constitution. That’s why I’m running for the Senate, but I need your
help:

Fellow American,

My mom was a schoolteacher growing up. Every single day she got up and went to educate the next generation of leaders... and she always told me, _**"Nothing will work unless you do".**_

And it is exactly what I’ve been doing since I was 17 when I dropped out of high school and started waitressing at the local Waffle House to put food on the table.

Like a lot of Americans, I struggled to make ends meet, living paycheck to paycheck as I also earned my high school diploma by taking classes at a technical college. I got by without government handouts or radical socialist policies – and I am a better woman because of it.

Friend, As part of Black History Month celebrations, I wanted to recognize and honor the long history of solidarity between Black people and Palestinians. The Movement for Black Lives and Black-led groups like Dream Defenders have been organizing for Palestinian liberation, continuing a lineage of Black American civil rights activists standing up against racism and imperialism around the world. Over 1,000 Black pastors have come out strongly for a ceasefire, demanding President Biden act now. Many name a shared struggle against oppression. Black Lives Matter protesters and Palestinians have connected on how to deal with repressive state violence, which makes sense: Israeli forces and U.S. police regularly train together. Continuing a tradition of Black South African solidarity with Palestinians, South Africa led the lawsuit against Israel at the International Court of Justice, which ordered Israel’s government to stop the genocide. **South African leaders who helped bring down that country’s apartheid system have long compared their experiences with Palestinians’ struggle under Israel’s apartheid regime.** Stripped of basic rights and subjected to a different legal system from Israelis, many Palestinians are locked up in jails for months or years without ever being charged. Palestinians have asked for boycotts, divestment, and sanctions to sway Israel’s government to change—tactics that were essential in ending South Africa’s apartheid. Black civil rights leaders also used boycotts to expand our freedoms in the United States, an important tool to end Jim Crow segregation. Creating bail funds to bail out protesters was another important tactic used during the civil rights movement. Bail funds are still used as important mutual aid for people who can’t afford bail, and who are otherwise forced to languish behind bars for long periods of time before trial. Just this week, the U.S. House of Representatives passed a bill to criminalize our free speech right to engage in political boycotts. And state legislatures around the country are also attacking bail funds. Georgia’s legislature just passed a bill to expand their state’s racist cash bail system and to criminalize bail funds. [**Please sign on to demand an end to racist policing, from the U.S. to Palestine. clean_body: Together, we will dismantle racist and oppressive systems. | | | Friend, As part of Black History Month celebrations, I wanted to recognize and honor the long history of solidarity between Black people and Palestinians. The Movement for Black Lives and Black-led groups like Dream Defenders have been organizing for Palestinian liberation, continuing a lineage of Black American civil rights activists standing up against racism and imperialism around the world. Over 1,000 Black pastors have come out strongly for a ceasefire, demanding President Biden act now. Many name a shared struggle against oppression. Black Lives Matter protesters and Palestinians have connected on how to deal with repressive state violence, which makes sense: Israeli forces and U.S. police regularly train together. Continuing a tradition of Black South African solidarity with Palestinians, South Africa led the lawsuit against Israel at the International Court of Justice, which ordered Israel’s government to stop the genocide. South African leaders who helped bring down that country’s apartheid system have long compared their experiences with Palestinians’ struggle under Israel’s apartheid regime. Stripped of basic rights and subjected to a different legal system from Israelis, many Palestinians are locked up in jails for months or years without ever being charged. Palestinians have asked for boycotts, divestment, and sanctions to sway Israel’s government to change—tactics that were essential in ending South Africa’s apartheid. Black civil rights leaders also used boycotts to expand our freedoms in the United States, an important tool to end Jim Crow segregation. Creating bail funds to bail out protesters was another important tactic used during the civil rights movement. Bail funds are still used as important mutual aid for people who can’t afford bail, and who are otherwise forced to languish behind bars for long periods of time before trial. Just this week, the U.S. House of Representatives passed a bill to criminalize our free speech right to engage in political boycotts. And state legislatures around the country are also attacking bail funds. Georgia’s legislature just passed a bill to expand their state’s racist cash bail system and to criminalize bail funds. | #StopCopCity protesters have drawn attention to the regular collaboration between U.S. military and police with Israeli forces, training with each other to suppress protests and maintain the unjust status quo. Israel’s military also supported South Africa’s military during its anti-Black apartheid regime. Their armed forces trained together, and they worked closely on weapons development, including nuclear weapons. When celebrating the end of South Africa’s racist apartheid, Nelson Mandela said: “We know too well that our freedom is incomplete without the freedom of the Palestinians.” Our struggles and our liberation are connected. We get free together. Together, we will dismantle racist, oppressive systems. We will keep growing movements for liberation and equality for all. name: Hill Harper
subject: It’s official, Peter — my name will be on the ballot for U.S. Senate
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY HILL HARPER FOR MICHIGAN
body:
And I’ll need you with me until the last one is counted
# [](https://act.hillharper.com/go/421?t=1&akid=975%2E62735%2Elx4j6O)
I wanted to let you know right away: I just filed to put my name on the ballot as a U.S. Senate candidate in Michigan!
I can’t tell you how much this moment means to me, Peter. Thousands of Michiganders signed on to signal their trust in me as their candidate for U.S. Senate. Dozens of volunteers took time out of their busy lives to collect signatures because they believe in our shared vision.
But getting my name on the ballot isn’t what this is all about. Rather, it’s about the priorities on the ballot: abortion access, climate justice, common-sense gun safety reforms, raising wages, strengthening unions, and delivering universal healthcare for all.
**Thanks to your ongoing support and to the incredible volunteers who helped secure more than 24,000 petition signatures, we are now one step closer to taking our people-powered movement all the way to Washington.**
**[Please, chip in $5 _right now_ to help us beat the odds, win this high-stakes Senate race, and put working Michigan families FIRST >>>](https://act.hillharper.com/go/427?t=4&akid=975%2E62735%2Elx4j6O)**
**[ARE YOU WITH ME?](https://act.hillharper.com/go/427?t=5&akid=975%2E62735%2Elx4j6O)**
As a union organizer, activist, single father, and the owner of a small business in Detroit, I understand the pressures Michiganders are facing right now:
* We pay **14 times more** for a vial of insulin than our neighbors to the north.
* We’re **49th** in the nation for growth.
* In the last three years, more small businesses **closed their doors for good** here than in any other state.

I _know_ we can win this race and get to work for Michigan, but Peter — I mean it when I say I’ll need you with me until the last ballot is counted.
My main opponent in the race is a career politician backed by the Washington elite and party insiders. They know a lot is riding on this race, and they’re working hard to make sure the establishment pick is the eventual Democratic nominee.
_That’s why I’m counting on your support more than ever right now._ **This is our chance to show everyone that working Michiganders don’t want more of the same bought-and-paid-for politicians leaving them behind.**
**[I can’t thank you enough for helping us get this far, but now, our eyes are set on the August primary. Please, rush a donation of $5 — or anything that works for you — to build our grassroots momentum in the coming months >>>](https://act.hillharper.com/go/427?t=8&akid=975%2E62735%2Elx4j6O)**
**[DONATE $5 »](https://act.hillharper.com/go/427?t=9&akid=975%2E62735%2Elx4j6O)**
Let’s do this!
Hill Harper
Democrat for U.S. Senate

| | | | Every Henson razor is manufactured using CNC machines. Our parts are never cast or molded. **Ok, sounds cool but what does this mean?** Machining allows us to hold tighter tolerances on each individual part, which is a critical component of our design. Even microscopic variances in blade exposure can lead to noticeable changes in the aggression of your shave. Similarly, if the blade is slightly more exposed at one end of the razor head, that inconsistency can lead to pulling or irritation. At scale, casting is typically faster, cheaper, and requires less material. But without the same flexibility on precision, we didn't feel comfortable proceeding with this approach. Ok, sounds cool but what does this mean? Machining allows us to hold tighter tolerances on each individual part, which is a critical component of our design. Even microscopic variances in blade exposure can lead to noticeable changes in the aggression of your shave. Similarly, if the blade is slightly more exposed at one end of the razor head, that inconsistency can lead to pulling or irritation. At scale, casting is typically faster, cheaper, and requires less material. But without the same flexibility on precision, we didn't feel comfortable proceeding with this approach. It's moments like these that fill me with immense pride for the East Tennessee community and our remarkable ability to come together in times of tragedy. As we reflect on Deputy McCowan's service and ultimate sacrifice, his memory serves as a shining example of the selfless dedication that defines law enforcement. He was a true hero who made the ultimate sacrifice in the line of duty, and my heart goes out to his family as they navigate this unimaginable loss. It didn’t go well. Instead of listening to the voter’s concerns about having his Democratic campaign powered by a far-right organization, **Jamaal’s opponent baselessly accused him of accepting campaign money from Hamas. 1** This outrageous attack is just the latest in a series of lies targeted at WFP champions who have stood up for a ceasefire to bring peace and security to people in Israel and Palestine. We can expect many of these lies — and worse — to be amplified by AIPAC spending, as they prepare to direct $100 million from right-wing billionaires to their campaign to unseat progressives in Congress. **[To counter these attacks and defend WFP champions like Reps. clean_body: | | | Peter, Over the weekend, a voter asked Jamaal Bowman’s primary challenger George Latimer about the $600,000 Latimer’s campaign has reportedly accepted through AIPAC and right wing donors. It didn’t go well. Instead of listening to the voter’s concerns about having his Democratic campaign powered by a far-right organization, Jamaal’s opponent baselessly accused him of accepting campaign money from Hamas. 1 This outrageous attack is just the latest in a series of lies targeted at WFP champions who have stood up for a ceasefire to bring peace and security to people in Israel and Palestine. We can expect many of these lies — and worse — to be amplified by AIPAC spending, as they prepare to direct $100 million from right-wing billionaires to their campaign to unseat progressives in Congress. AIPAC (the American Israel Public Affairs Committee) has spent years supporting extremist MAGA Republicans, including those who tried to overturn the 2020 election. Now, they’re setting their sights on Democratic primaries, recruiting candidates to run against WFP champions in office and pouring massive amounts of money into their campaigns. AIPAC and its candidates have also been making absurd and despicable attacks on our champions, including censuring Rep. Rashida Tlaib by claiming she supported “brutal rapes, murders, be-headings, and kidnapping” and using a mistranslated video to accuse Rep. Ilhan Omar, who immigrated to the United States as a child to escape a civil war, of being a “foreign agent” and “terrorist sympathizer.” While these attacks may be outrageous lies, if voters don’t get to hear the truth, they may end up believing them. And, we could face very real losses in primaries that begin in just a few weeks. In solidarity, Working Families Party Source: 1\. , City & State New York, February 13, 2024 Thoughts? Feedback? We need rockstars!
We are searching for exceptional talent like you to join our team of rockstar Kennedy State Directors!
The Kennedy campaign seeks nationwide grassroots support to collect hundreds of thousands of signatures, ensuring every American can freely vote for their chosen candidate in November.
Do you know a driven, creative, and empowered problem-solver? Someone with a knack for finding solutions amidst challenges? A natural advocate who connects with everyone and inspires others to excel?
If so, we invite you to send them our way!
As a Team Kennedy State Coordinator, you will pave the way to [ballot access in your state](https://www.kennedy24.com/ballot-access?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=job_description_2_12_24_1as&n=2), leading petitioning efforts, mobilizing communities, and driving impactful change. This is a unique opportunity for field leaders ready to leave an indelible mark on our nation's path, as Mr. Kennedy has unique requirements to get on the ballot in every state this November.
To apply, please email your resume and a brief introduction to [jobs@teamkennedy.com](mailto:jobs@teamkennedy.com) We eagerly await exceptional individuals like you, ready to make history.
Join our team and let's revolutionize the course of history together!
* * *
Job Title: State Coordinator - Team Kennedy 2024
Location: We are currently hiring directors for the following states: Missouri, Indiana, Illinois, Montana, Oregon, West Virginia
Job Type: Full-time, 40 - 50 Hours Per Week
Compensation: $5,000 per month
Qualifications:
* State residency.
* Proven expertise in field petitioning and leadership capacities.
* Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
* Demonstrated skill in volunteer management and motivation.
* Excellent interpersonal and team-building capabilities.
* Flexibility to undertake extensive travel.
* Proficiency in Google Suite tools.
* Experience with mass email and texting campaigns and familiarity with CRMs preferred.

Responsibilities:
Ballot Access Petitioning:
* A proactive approach to learning the ballot access requirements specific to your state, including key deadlines, geographic considerations, and infrastructure needed to meet your weekly petition targets
* Ensure adherence to campaign standards and state regulations, leading by example.
* Coordinate volunteers to secure a minimum of 500 petition signatures per week within your state
* Identify and secure presence at key events in your state such as conventions, trade shows, festivals, etc., securing tables or booths for signature collection
* Organize volunteer shifts at event venues, and identify high-traffic areas for petitioning such as parks, post offices, sidewalks and other public spaces

Leadership:
* Provide clear direction to campaign teams, setting goals and driving outcomes.
* Develop retention strategies and inspire volunteer engagement.
* Articulate and promote Robert Kennedy Jr.'s vision for the nation and our collective future
* Maintain regular in-person and online events for your state volunteers and county/regional organizers

Volunteer Recruitment and Management:
* Recruit, train, and oversee an active volunteer base in your state to maximize campaign impact.
* Coordinate and delegate tasks among state volunteers and county/regional coordinators to optimize efficiency.
* Foster a culture of camaraderie, creativity, dedication, and proactive problem-solving among state staff, county leaders, and volunteers

Exceptional Organization:
* Maintain meticulous organization across campaign activities, including events, volunteer management, and outreach.
* Implement efficient data management systems and reporting procedures.
* Employ innovative strategies to overcome logistical hurdles and consistently surpass weekly objectives

Technology:
* Proficient in managing basic technology such as email communication tools, Google Suite, online supporter databases, and canvassing apps (required)
* Managing mass email and texting campaigns, ideally with NationBuilder CRM. (preferred)
* Ensure team members are proficient in utilizing these tools.
* Ability to utilize digital platforms, and social media (preferred)

Travel:
* Willingness to travel within and beyond the state to support petitioning efforts.
* Coordinate travel logistics to maximize statewide campaign coverage.

How to Apply:
If you possess the outlined experience and skills, please submit your resume and a cover letter detailing your relevant experience to [jobs@teamkennedy.com](mailto:jobs@teamkennedy.com).

body:
Exciting news! One of our top priority bills for the 2024 legislative session is heading to a vote in the Senate next Tuesday (Feb. 20)! This is the first of our priority bills to head to a vote and we want to make sure it sails through the Senate. Will you urge your Senator to vote YES on the Right to Repair Act (SB 1596)? [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/79163179/455630797/-377656563?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjNhODc4MmUzLTBkY2QtZWUxMS04NWY5LTAwMjI0ODIyMzc5NCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=OzYFbHXBMupK5qLbUmXOXG39aC23TJyR354wwtZs4M8=&emci=57397958-06cd-ee11-85f9-002248223794&emdi=3a8782e3-0dcd-ee11-85f9-002248223794&ceid=2107230) | | | Dear Peter,

Exciting news! One of our top priority bills for the 2024 legislative session is heading to a vote in the Senate next Tuesday (Feb. 20)! This is the first of our priority bills to head to a vote and we want to make sure it sails through the Senate. **[Will you urge your Senator to vote YES on the Right to Repair Act (SB 1596)?](https://click.everyaction.com/k/79163180/455630798/-1220809692?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjNhODc4MmUzLTBkY2QtZWUxMS04NWY5LTAwMjI0ODIyMzc5NCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=OzYFbHXBMupK5qLbUmXOXG39aC23TJyR354wwtZs4M8=&emci=57397958-06cd-ee11-85f9-002248223794&emdi=3a8782e3-0dcd-ee11-85f9-002248223794&ceid=2107230) **

Once upon a time not that long ago, when you bought a product it came with a manual, it was relatively easy to repair, and its parts were widely available. Not so much anymore. Manufacturers of electronics and appliances too often require consumers to go back to the manufacturer or their “authorized service providers.” These legal, digital and physical barriers make it all but impossible for the owner of the product to repair their own stuff.

To solve those problems, the Right to Repair Act would require manufacturing companies to make the diagnostic tools, information, replacement parts and tools available to consumers and third party repair shops, so Oregonians can more easily and affordably fix our stuff––similar to how we repair our cars.

**Passing the Right to Repair Act Will:**
* **Save Families Money:** Being able to fix phones, computers, and appliances instead of buying new would save the average Oregon household $382 per year. That adds up to $649 million in savings across all Oregon households.
* **Reduce E-Waste:** Partly because repair and reuse is so difficult, Oregonians dispose of an estimated 4,800 cell phones every day. E-waste is the fastest growing waste stream in the world, and it adds toxic heavy metals like lead, mercury, and cadmium into our landfills. With more repair, these materials will remain in use instead of filling up landfills, be more useful for recyclers, and reduce the burden of new source material, manufacturing, and transportation of new devices.
* **Cut Pollution:** Since 85% of the energy and climate impact associated with a smartphone comes from manufacturing, it’s estimated that if every Oregonian extended the life of their phone by just one year, it would be the equivalent of removing 8,100 cars off the road in terms of climate emission.

[**For all of these reasons please ask your Senator to vote YES on the Right to Repair Act!**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/79163181/455630799/-1220809692?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjNhODc4MmUzLTBkY2QtZWUxMS04NWY5LTAwMjI0ODIyMzc5NCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=OzYFbHXBMupK5qLbUmXOXG39aC23TJyR354wwtZs4M8=&emci=57397958-06cd-ee11-85f9-002248223794&emdi=3a8782e3-0dcd-ee11-85f9-002248223794&ceid=2107230)

Thank you,

Julia DeGraw
Coalition Director, OLCV | |

clean_body: Exciting news! One of our top priority bills for the 2024 legislative session is heading to a vote in the Senate next Tuesday (Feb. 20)! This is the first of our priority bills to head to a vote and we want to make sure it sails through the Senate. Will you urge your Senator to vote YES on the Right to Repair Act (SB 1596)? | | | Dear Peter, Exciting news! One of our top priority bills for the 2024 legislative session is heading to a vote in the Senate next Tuesday (Feb. 20)! This is the first of our priority bills to head to a vote and we want to make sure it sails through the Senate. Once upon a time not that long ago, when you bought a product it came with a manual, it was relatively easy to repair, and its parts were widely available. Not so much anymore. Manufacturers of electronics and appliances too often require consumers to go back to the manufacturer or their “authorized service providers.” These legal, digital and physical barriers make it all but impossible for the owner of the product to repair their own stuff. To solve those problems, the Right to Repair Act would require manufacturing companies to make the diagnostic tools, information, replacement parts and tools available to consumers and third party repair shops, so Oregonians can more easily and affordably fix our stuff––similar to how we repair our cars. Passing the Right to Repair Act Will: Save Families Money: Being able to fix phones, computers, and appliances instead of buying new would save the average Oregon household $382 per year. That adds up to $649 million in savings across all Oregon households. Reduce E-Waste: Partly because repair and reuse is so difficult, Oregonians dispose of an estimated 4,800 cell phones every day. E-waste is the fastest growing waste stream in the world, and it adds toxic heavy metals like lead, mercury, and cadmium into our landfills. With more repair, these materials will remain in use instead of filling up landfills, be more useful for recyclers, and reduce the burden of new source material, manufacturing, and transportation of new devices. Cut Pollution:** Since 85% of the energy and climate impact associated with a smartphone comes from manufacturing, it’s estimated that if every Oregonian extended the life of their phone by just one year, it would be the equivalent of removing 8,100 cars off the road in terms of climate emission. Look: I’m the only person in this race who is born, raised, and educated right here in AZ-01. I went to school at Kiva, Mohave, and Saguaro where so many students are still learning today. I’m deeply invested in our community because this is where I grew up and learned the values that still drive me today.

And that’s why seeing how much the public schools in our community are suffering right now is so heartbreaking for me as I’m sure it is for you.

Last week, Eleanor, my elementary school daughter, went to school without a teacher. Twice. The sad fact is that this isn’t the first time this has happened, and if we don't do something it won’t be the last. We continue to face major teacher shortages across our state and country, and not enough is being done to fix it.

One of my top priorities in my campaign for Congress is to be an advocate for our schools, something my opponent, Rep. Shweikert, can’t say.

Last week in York, a woman signed my petition with a poignant message. She said:

_“I grew up in Croatia. I am a proud American. I have seen firsthand the brutality of Putin’s Soviet Union. You must defeat Scott Perry and Donald Trump! If Trump is ever President again, he will partner with Putin, and they will carve up Eastern Europe!”_

I know exactly what she means. Serving as a peacekeeper in Eastern Europe, I heard many stories of repression and cruelty. America needs nothing like it, and I won’t let it happen here.

“Moscow First!” surrenders the United States’ position of global leadership to Russia and China. It’s that simple. It is an invitation to World War III.

No one in the world will trust America to stand by them. Russia will be encouraged to invade the Baltic countries, and China to invade Taiwan. The cost in lives and dollars will be beyond calculation.

The best system of government ever invented for ordinary people – democracy – will be seen as a failure. Corruption and repression of those who dare to speak out – like Alexei Navalny – will flourish. The Bill of Rights will be shredded, and free speech will be replaced by government propaganda.

The dollar – the most trusted currency in the world – will be replaced by the Chinese Yuan, costing Americans millions of jobs and propelling inflation.

Nothing good comes from refusing to spend 1% of the United States budget defending democracy.

Nothing good comes from Scott Perry’s continued presence in the House.

Hello,
Every time I see a new attack on abortion rights and women’s reproductive freedoms, I think of my dad.
For the first few years of my life, my family lived on an Indian reservation in Northern Montana. Dad was an OB-GYN – in the years before _Roe v. Wade_ ...

Looking back, having a father who provided women with access to health care – especially at a time when so many were being denied the right – really shaped how I think about the issue.
My dad is in his 80’s and retired now, but for years, he helped train the next generation of health care providers at Planned Parenthood. And my sister, who later also became an OB-GYN, is continuing on his legacy.
**Extremists like Lauren Boebert and my new Republican opponents want you to think that women having the freedom to make their own medical decisions is some extreme idea. It’s not.**

Their views are a fringe one – supported by people who think that the government should be dictating women’s medical decisions, instead of allowing women the freedom to make choices with their doctor.

Peter,

My mom was a schoolteacher growing up. Every single day she got up and went to educate the next generation of leaders... and she always told me, _**"Nothing will work unless you do".**_

And it is exactly what I’ve been doing since I was 17 when I dropped out of high school and started waitressing at the local Waffle House to put food on the table.

Like a lot of Americans, I struggled to make ends meet, living paycheck to paycheck as I also earned my high school diploma by taking classes at a technical college. I got by without government handouts or radical socialist policies – and I am a better woman because of it.

**Well, Peter, I took those same ideals I learned as a Waffle House waitress to Congress. I refuse to waiver to what anyone wants other than the constituents I was elected by,_even if it means pissing off some party members along the way._**

| | Greetings #TeamAlsobrooks, Another great week on the campaign trail! Thank you to everyone who came out to support us this past week. Your efforts to boost the campaign are going to be what takes us over the finish line. Let's keep fighting the good fight to have a better future for all Marylanders. We started the week off strong, announcing our first campaign commercial! You can **[watch the ad here.](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/12159?t=7&akid=1079%2E52803%2EySdDsM)** In case you missed it, here’s what’s been happening for the past week on the campaign trail and beyond: In Baltimore, we were joined by over 200 people for our 100 Men for Alsobrooks event. Thank you to our amazing host committee, including Congressman John Sarbanes, Congressman Kweisi Mfume, Senator Cory McCray, County Executive Johnny Olszewski for gathering such an incredible crowd on a Saturday morning. [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/12168?t=26&amount=25&akid=1079%2E52803%2EySdDsM) We stopped by Su Casa Furniture store in Baltimore, where we had a great conversation with their manager Nick about how we can further support Baltimore residents and local businesses. By providing access to capital and investing in our communities, we can revitalize communities and small businesses across Maryland. [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/12168?t=27&amount=25&akid=1079%2E52803%2EySdDsM) Angela stopped by Jinji Chocolates in Northeast Baltimore for some tasty treats. The founders, Jinji and Guy Fraser, collaborate with cacao farmers to ensure that they are paid equitable wages while preserving the land they grow their product on. We also discussed how important land and climate protection is to them and how their business model could be applied to other businesses across the country. [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/12168?t=28&amount=25&akid=1079%2E52803%2EySdDsM) How wonderful it was to meet Monesha Phillips and to visit her store, Pandora’s Box in South Baltimore, filled with whimsical trinkets and amazing little knick knacks. We are simply in awe of the creativity and the innovation that entrepreneurs like Monesha possess across Maryland. [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/12168?t=29&amount=25&akid=1079%2E52803%2EySdDsM) While making our way around Baltimore, we stopped by Franchesca’s Empanadas Café for lunch, where the empanadas were absolutely delectable and packed with flavor! The owner, Franchesca, saw the need for an empanada restaurant in Baltimore, and as a result, created a space for the community to gather for some good food. [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/12168?t=30&amount=25&akid=1079%2E52803%2EySdDsM) We spent some time touring the historic Pennsylvania Ave Main Street in Baltimore. We had the pleasure of visiting the Pennsylvania Avenue Market, home to many wonderful, thriving small businesses. It’s crucial we expand access to capital for minority owned businesses as they are pivotal to the success of our communities and local economies. [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/12168?t=31&amount=25&akid=1079%2E52803%2EySdDsM) It was wonderful to celebrate Valentine’s Day at the ATU Local 689’s annual Sweetheart Ball. Thank you to President Ray Jackson for inviting us to join the festivities! We are honored by your continued support! [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/12168?t=32&amount=25&akid=1079%2E52803%2EySdDsM) Sunday morning, we worshiped with Congressman Kweisi Mfume and his super bad wife Dr. Mfume at the New Shiloh Baptist Church in Baltimore. Thank you to Pastor Dr. Harold Carter for a wonderful service and powerful sermon. [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/12168?t=33&amount=25&akid=1079%2E52803%2EySdDsM) [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/12168?t=24&amount=25&akid=1079%2E52803%2EySdDsM) **NEWS OF THE WEEK** **[Angela Alsobrooks airs first campaign commercial](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/12160?t=8&akid=1079%2E52803%2EySdDsM)**
_“My name is Angela Alsobrooks and I’m in the fight for all of us because your concerns are mine too.”_ **[[VIDEO] Angela Alsobrooks announces endorsements of West Baltimore leaders](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/12161?t=9&akid=1079%2E52803%2EySdDsM)**
_Check out our video on Twitter from our most recent round of West Baltimore Endorsements_ **[Alsobrooks hits the airwaves in a Senate race transformed by Hogan](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/12162?t=10&akid=1079%2E52803%2EySdDsM)**
_“Prince George’s County Executive Angela Alsobrooks (D)...went up with her first TV ad of the campaign Monday.”_ **[Alsobrooks up on the air in Maryland](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/12163?t=11&akid=1079%2E52803%2EySdDsM)**
_“Angela Alsobrooks, the Prince George’s County executive running for Senate in Maryland, is up on the air with her first ad of the primary campaign.”_ **[Talk of the Town: Prince George's County Executive Angela Alsobrooks](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/12164?t=12&akid=1079%2E52803%2EySdDsM)**
_“Prince George's County Executive Angela Alsobrooks joined Fox 5 DC to share updates for residents.”_ I know what you’re thinking... 🤔 Where did #TeamAlsbrooks get those cool shirts and how can I get one ??? [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/12165?t=13&akid=1079%2E52803%2EySdDsM) Well the good news is, our campaign store is now live! Grab some merch you can wear to our next campaign event: **[Team Alsobrooks Campaign Store!](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/12165?t=14&akid=1079%2E52803%2EySdDsM)** We’re extremely excited to announce that we’re accepting applications for our Fellowship Program aimed at high school and college students. If you know a young person looking to get some hands-on experience in politics, encourage them to apply **[here!](http://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/9723?t=15&akid=1079%2E52803%2EySdDsM)** Find upcoming events near you at **[angelaalsobrooks.com/events](http://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/12166?t=16&akid=1079%2E52803%2EySdDsM)**
Can’t volunteer in person? Join a remote volunteer team at **[angelaalsobrooks.com/digivol](http://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/12167?t=17&akid=1079%2E52803%2EySdDsM)** Here on Team Alsobrooks, we’re proud to be a campaign powered by grassroots donors. We believe in Angela's ability to go further and do better for our communities, and we know you do too! It’s going to take all of us working together to get Angela over the finish line this November. | | | [Volunteer](https://alsobrooks.actionkit.com/signup/volunteer-form?t=18&akid=1079%2E52803%2EySdDsM)

You can In case you missed it, here’s what’s been happening for the past week on the campaign trail and beyond: In Baltimore, we were joined by over 200 people for our 100 Men for Alsobrooks event. Thank you to our amazing host committee, including Congressman John Sarbanes, Congressman Kweisi Mfume, Senator Cory McCray, County Executive Johnny Olszewski for gathering such an incredible crowd on a Saturday morning. We stopped by Su Casa Furniture store in Baltimore, where we had a great conversation with their manager Nick about how we can further support Baltimore residents and local businesses. By providing access to capital and investing in our communities, we can revitalize communities and small businesses across Maryland. Angela stopped by Jinji Chocolates in Northeast Baltimore for some tasty treats. The founders, Jinji and Guy Fraser, collaborate with cacao farmers to ensure that they are paid equitable wages while preserving the land they grow their product on. We also discussed how important land and climate protection is to them and how their business model could be applied to other businesses across the country. How wonderful it was to meet Monesha Phillips and to visit her store, Pandora’s Box in South Baltimore, filled with whimsical trinkets and amazing little knick knacks. We are simply in awe of the creativity and the innovation that entrepreneurs like Monesha possess across Maryland. While making our way around Baltimore, we stopped by Franchesca’s Empanadas Café for lunch, where the empanadas were absolutely delectable and packed with flavor! The owner, Franchesca, saw the need for an empanada restaurant in Baltimore, and as a result, created a space for the community to gather for some good food. We spent some time touring the historic Pennsylvania Ave Main Street in Baltimore. We had the pleasure of visiting the Pennsylvania Avenue Market, home to many wonderful, thriving small businesses. It’s crucial we expand access to capital for minority owned businesses as they are pivotal to the success of our communities and local economies. It was wonderful to celebrate Valentine’s Day at the ATU Local 689’s annual Sweetheart Ball. Thank you to President Ray Jackson for inviting us to join the festivities! We are honored by your continued support! Sunday morning, we worshiped with Congressman Kweisi Mfume and his super bad wife Dr. Mfume at the New Shiloh Baptist Church in Baltimore. Thank you to Pastor Dr. Harold Carter for a wonderful service and powerful sermon. NEWS OF THE WEEK “My name is Angela Alsobrooks and I’m in the fight for all of us because your concerns are mine too.” [[VIDEO] Angela Alsobrooks announces endorsements of West Baltimore leaders]() Check out our video on Twitter from our most recent round of West Baltimore Endorsements “Prince George’s County Executive Angela Alsobrooks (D)...went up with her first TV ad of the campaign Monday.” “Angela Alsobrooks, the Prince George’s County executive running for Senate in Maryland, is up on the air with her first ad of the primary campaign.” “Prince George's County Executive Angela Alsobrooks joined Fox 5 DC to share updates for residents.” I know what you’re thinking... 🤔 Where did #TeamAlsbrooks get those cool shirts and how can I get one ??? Well the good news is, our campaign store is now live! Grab some merch you can wear to our next campaign event: We’re extremely excited to announce that we’re accepting applications for our Fellowship Program aimed at high school and college students. If you know a young person looking to get some hands-on experience in politics, encourage them to apply Find upcoming events near you at Can’t volunteer in person? Join a remote volunteer team at Here on Team Alsobrooks, we’re proud to be a campaign powered by grassroots donors. We believe in Angela's ability to go further and do better for our communities, and we know you do too! It’s going to take all of us working together to get Angela over the finish line this November. | | | | | SOCIALS While we'll keep sending emails to keep you updated, the best way to keep up with Angela is on our social media channels. body:
Here’s what it means for our race.
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1145%2E135344%2E1JHGki)

In 2020, Donald Trump made more visits to Michigan than almost any other state in the country.
Tomorrow, he's coming back. It will already be his 3rd trip in the 2024 race.
So what does his trip mean?
First, let's state the obvious: there is no winning the White House in 2024 without winning Michigan. That goes for Joe Biden, and that goes for Donald Trump.
So this trip will be the next of many because Trump knows he needs to keep his supporters consistently motivated between now and November. Every time he visits he gets more volunteer activity and he gets more media attention -- both things he wants for his campaign.
It's also a chance for him to rally and organize more Michigan donors, the small-dollar ones and the deep-pocketed ones that will fund huge independent expenditures in the state.
All of this impacts our race.
If someone turns out for Trump, there is a decent chance they are turning out for the Republican nominee in our Senate race.
But we are not powerless in this campaign.
Because every person we turn out in our race is also likely a vote to keep Trump out of the White House. And the truth is, we have always done better than most Democrats do in some of those "redder" parts of the state.
So this is a big moment for us. We need to do our best to match the energy Trump generates for Republicans in Michigan. Because it is not just our race and control of the Senate for Democrats on the line in Michigan, but it's also the White House.
So please:

Do you know the difference between the other candidates running for Governor and me?
_**I’m willing to get things done.**_
I served our country in the **US Air Force Reserves** and then in the King County Sheriff’s office for 33 years, before serving as the **King County Sheriff** from 1997 to 2005. Keeping our communities safe was my #1 priority, especially as we worked on solving the Green River Killer case.

I’ve had the honor of serving our great state in Congress from 2005 to 2019, when I had the opportunity to fight for common sense solutions to the many problems facing our country.

I’m also a **father** and **grandfather** who’s willing to do anything to protect my family. **So believe me, securing our state is the first item on my agenda.**

| Hi Peter,

| | The right to privacy is a profoundly and fundamentally American concept. But in this day and age, the lines between public and private are becoming increasingly blurred. Each day, we become increasingly reliant upon new technologies for convenience and connection with loved ones. Unfortunately, many of these technologies come with a price: the privacy of our data. A kind of economy has formed around the collection, storage, and distribution of all the information that can be gleaned about you from various sources. Everything from your browsing history to location data are up for grabs and auctioned off to nearly anyone with a credit card. All of these bits and pieces of information are valuable to companies in the digital age. But it feels like not a day goes by that we're not waking up to a headline about how a company or bank failed to protect your private information - or even sold it to shady data brokers looking to abuse your personal information. There have to be ironclad protections in place to protect consumer data, _and_ real consequences for companies that fail to protect it. That's exactly what I've been fighting to do in the Senate. As the Senate's resident "privacy hawk" my staff and I have been working hard to ensure that your personal data stays _personal_. Here are a few recent successful efforts:
* First, at my urging, Google reduced the amount of consumer location data they will collect and store in an effort to prevent red states from weaponizing data against women who have sought an abortion.
* Second, in response to my requests, Meta (Facebook) announced that it would encrypt direct messages (DMs) between users, meaning the DMs you send to another person on the platform will finally have strong protections.
* Third, after I called on Apple to require a court order before handing consumer data about push notifications over to authorities, the company announced that it would implement that as standard practice.

Though these changes may seem small, they show that progress on this issue is possible. I'm not going to back down from fighting to protect your constitutional right to privacy from every angle. subject: Quick update on our work
body:
| | | | [View this email in your browser](https://us1.campaign-archive.com/?e=17913c7d6d&u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=e31760eabf)
---
| | |
---
| | | Friends,

There’s a lot of noise in Washington this week but we’re focused on battles that we’re determined to win. Here is a quick update.

It’s no secret that D.C. is rife with corruption. But we can’t become complacent to it or rely on the media to root it out, especially when it’s coming from a ranking Democrat member of Congress–and one used as a tool of the radical Left.

That’s why CRA filed an **ethics complaint against Rep. Jamie Raskin (D) l** ast week for violating federal financial disclosure law by not reporting his wife’s income and stock portfolio.

_Make no mistake_ , Raskin’s violations are serious and pose a potential conflict of interest in his capacity as a member of Congress. In our complaint we call on the Office of Congressional Ethics (“OCE”) to open an official investigation into his lack of disclosure.

**READ:[CRA Files Ethics Complaint Against Raskin](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=5f3d2babe8&e=17913c7d6d)

Coverage in Fox Business: [Top House Dem faces renewed ethics complaint over wife's $1.5M stock payday](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=3d66a1f23c&e=17913c7d6d)**

---
| [ ](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=b1ecafec4d&e=17913c7d6d)
---
| As I told Fox Business, "It is imperative that Members disclose assets that they or their families have in compliance with the law so that the public can assess what may be motivating a Member to take certain positions or actions.”

We’ve done the research and made the credible case that the Office of Congressional Ethics MUST investigate whether Raskin "engaged in any actions to benefit his wife’s clients, and specifically Reserve Trust, during the time period for which he did not disclose this asset."
---
| **Pushing Back Against the Globalist NATO Narrative**
---
| [ ](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=5e9e1b7728&e=17913c7d6d)
---
| This past week, in an [interview](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=b3e49f7311&e=17913c7d6d) with the Financial Times, I pushed back against the globalist narrative that the U.S. must shoulder the burden for funding NATO.

As I told FT, “the old idea of NATO’’s collective defense needs to be reassessed.” The vast majority of European member countries to the organization give less than 2% of their GDP to NATO, while the U.S. funds more than any other nation to NATO and has poured more than $113 billion into the war in Ukraine.

Meanwhile, the foreign policy establishment in Washington calls our agenda “isolationism.” It’s time to base our foreign policy on mutual interest with our partners and preserving the strength to defend our interests. It’s time for our foreign policy to put America first.

**CRA Policy Brief:[Pivoting the US Away from Europe to a Dormant NATO](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=6965e82b20&e=17913c7d6d)
CRA Resource: [NATO Contributions Fact Sheet](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=ec6032806e&e=17913c7d6d)**
---
| **CRA’s Steve Friend Exposes FBI’ “Juking the Stats” **
---
| [ ](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=f3adce58ba&e=17913c7d6d)
---
| My colleague Steve Friend [took to the airwaves](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=2d821fad59&e=17913c7d6d) this week to expose the latest efforts by law enforcement to “juke the stats” in regards to the Lakewood Church Shooter. Meaning, the FBI refusing to acknowledge the gender of the female shooter and intentionally labeling her as “non-Hispanic” is the textbook woke ideology in law enforcement that the CRA team is identifying and exposing weaponization across the country.

Thanks for staying in the fight with us. [We couldn’t do it without you](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=2f9ffd68ad&e=17913c7d6d).
---
| Sincerely,

Russ Vought
President, Center for Renewing America
